dn16:1.1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
dn16:1.1.3: tena kho pana samayena rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto vajjī abhiyātukāmo hoti.
dn16:1.1.5: ‘ahaṃ hi ime vajjī evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve ucchecchāmi, vināsessāmi vajjī, anayabyasanaṃ āpādessāmi vajjī’ti.
dn16:1.2.1: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto vassakāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ magadhamahāmattaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:1.2.2: “ehi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama. upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi. appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha:
dn16:1.2.3: ‘rājā bhante, māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati. appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī’ti.
dn16:1.2.5: ‘rājā bhante, māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto vajjī abhiyātukāmo hoti.
dn16:1.2.7: ahaṃ hi ime vajjī evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve ucchecchāmi, vināsessa mi vajjī, anayabyasanaṃ āpādessāmi vajjī’ti.
dn16:1.2.8: yathā ca te bhagavā byākaroti, taṃ sādhukaṃ uggahetvā mama āroceyyāsi.
dn16:1.3.1: ‘evaṃ bho’ti kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa paṭissutvā, bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojāpetvā, bhaddaṃ yānaṃ abhirūhitvā, bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi rājagahamhā niyyāsi. yena gijjhakūṭo pabbato tena pāyāsi.
dn16:1.3.2: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattiko’va yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
dn16:1.3.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:1.3.4: “rājā bho gotama, māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhoto gotamassa pāde sirasā vandati. appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati.
dn16:1.3.5: rājā bho gotama, māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto vajjī abhiyātukāmo.
dn16:1.3.7: ahaṃ hi ime vajjī evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve ucchecchāmi, vināsessāmi vajjī anayabyasanaṃ āpādessāmi vajjī”ti. [vajjīnaṃ satta aparihāniyā dhammā:]
dn16:1.4.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ānando bhagavato piṭṭhito ṭhito hoti bhagavantaṃ vījayamāno.
dn16:1.4.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:1.4.5: “yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjī abhiṇhasannipātā sannipātabahulā bhavissanti vuddhiyeva ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.” (1)
dn16:1.4.6: “kinti te ānanda, sutaṃ: vajjī samaggā sannipātanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahanti, samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karontīti?”
dn16:1.4.7: “sutammetaṃ bhante, vajjī samaggā sannipatanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahanti, samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karontī”ti.
dn16:1.4.8: “yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjī samaggā sannipatissanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahissanti, samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karissanti, vuddhiyeva ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.” (2)
dn16:1.4.9: “kinti te ānanda, sutaṃ: vajjī apaññattaṃ na paññapenti, paññattaṃ na samucchindanti, yathāpaññatte porāṇe vajjidhamme samādāya vattantīti?”
dn16:1.4.10: “sutammetaṃ bhante, vajjī apaññattaṃ na paññapenti, paññattaṃ na samucchindanti, yathāpaññatte porāṇe vajjidhamme samādāya vattantī”ti.
dn16:1.4.11: “yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjī apaññattaṃ na paññapessanti, paññattaṃ na samucchindissanti, yathāpaññatte porāṇe vajjidhamme samādāya vattissanti, vuddhiyeva ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni. (3)
dn16:1.4.12: kinti te ānanda, sutaṃ: vajjī ye te vajjīnaṃ vajjimahallakā, te sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjenti, tesañca sotabbaṃ maññantīti?”
dn16:1.4.13: “sutammetaṃ bhante, vajjī ye te vajjīnaṃ vajjimahallakā, te sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjenti, tesañca sotabbaṃ maññantī”ti.
dn16:1.4.14: “yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjī ye te vajjīnaṃ vajjimahallakā, te sakkarissanti garukarissanti mānessanti pūjessanti, tesañca sotabbaṃ maññissanti, vuddhiyeva ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.” (4)
dn16:1.4.15: “kinti te ānanda, sutaṃ: “vajjī yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo tā na okkassa pasayha vāsentī?”ti.
dn16:1.4.16: “sutammetaṃ bhante, vajjī yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo, tā na okkassa pasayha vāsentī”ti.
dn16:1.4.17: “yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjī yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo, tā na okkassa pasayha vāsessanti, vuddhiyeva ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni. (5)
dn16:1.4.18: “kinti te ānanda, sutaṃ: vajjī yāni tāni vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni ceva bāhirāni ca, tāni sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjenti, tesañca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpentīti?”
dn16:1.4.19: “sutammetaṃ bhante, vajjī yāni tāni vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni ceva bāhirāni ca, tāni sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjenti, tesañca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpentī”ti.
dn16:1.4.20: “yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjī yāni tāni vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni ceva bāhirāni ca, tāni sakkarissanti garukarissanti mānessanti pūjessanti, tesañca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpessanti, vuddhiyeva ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.” (6)
dn16:1.4.21: “kinti te ānanda, sutaṃ: vajjīnaṃ arahantesu dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇagutti susaṃvihitā: kinti anāgatā ca arahanto vijitaṃ āgaccheyyuṃ, āgatā ca arahanto vijite phāsuṃ vihareyyunti?”
dn16:1.4.22: “sutammetaṃ bhante vajjīnaṃ arahantesu dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇagutti susaṃvihitā: kinti anāgatā ca arahanto vijitaṃ āgaccheyyuṃ, āgatā ca arahanto vijite phāsuṃ vihareyyunti.”
dn16:1.4.23: “yāvakīvañca ānanda, vajjīnaṃ arahantesu dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇagutti susaṃvihitā bhavissanti: kinti anāgatā ca arahanto vijitaṃ āgaccheyyuṃ, āgatā ca arahanto vijite phāsuṃ vihareyyunti, vuddhiyeva ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī’ti.” (7)
dn16:1.5.1: atha kho bhagavā vassakāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ magadhamahāmattaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:1.5.2: “ekamidāhaṃ brāhmaṇa samayaṃ vesāliyaṃ viharāmi sārandade cetiye.
dn16:1.5.3: tatrāhaṃ vajjīnaṃ ime satta aparihāniye dhamme desesiṃ.
dn16:1.5.4: yāvakīvañca brāhmaṇa, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā vajjīsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu vajjī sandississanti, vuddhiyeva brāhmaṇa, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī”ti.
dn16:1.5.5: [iti vajjīnaṃ satta aparihāniyā dhammā.] evaṃ vutte vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:1.5.6: ekamekenāpi bho gotama, aparihāniyena dhammena samannāgatānaṃ vajjīnaṃ vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni,
dn16:1.5.7: ko pana vādo sattahi aparihāniyehi dhammehi,
dn16:1.5.8: akaraṇīyā’va, bho gotama vajjī raññā māgadhena ajātasattunā vedehiputtena yadidaṃ yuddhassa, aññatra upalāpanāya aññatra mithubhedā.
dn16:1.5.9: “handa ca’dāni mayaṃ bho gotama, gacchāma, bahukiccā mayaṃ bahukaraṇīyā”ti.
dn16:1.5.11: atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
dn16:1.6.1: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkante vassakāre brāhmaṇe magadhamahāmatte āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:1.6.2: “gaccha tvaṃ ānanda, yāvatikā bhikkhū rājagahaṃ upanissāya viharanti, te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātehī”ti.
dn16:1.6.3: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā yāvatikā bhikkhū rājagahaṃ upanissāya viharanti, te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:1.6.4: “sannipātito bhante bhikkhusaṅgho. yassa’dāni bhante bhagavā kālaṃ maññatī”ti. [1.
dn16:1.6.5: bhikkhūnaṃ satta aparihāniyā dhammā:] atha kho bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena upaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn16:1.6.8: taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī”ti.
dn16:1.6.9: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
dn16:1.6.11: “yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū abhiṇhasannipātā sannipātabahulā bhavissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (1)
dn16:1.6.12: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū samaggā sannipatissanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahissanti, samaggā saṅghakaraṇīyāni karissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (2)
dn16:1.6.13: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū apaññattaṃ na paññapessanti, paññattaṃ na samucchindissanti, yathāpaññattesu sikkhāpadesu samādāya vattissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (3)
dn16:1.6.14: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghaparināyakā, te sakkarissanti garukarissanti mānessanti pūjessanti, tesañca sotabbaṃ maññissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (4)
dn16:1.6.15: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū uppannāya taṇhāya ponobhavikāya na vasaṃ gacchanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (5)
dn16:1.6.16: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū āraññakesu senāsanesu sāpekkhā bhavissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (6)
dn16:1.6.17: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū paccattaññeva satiṃ upaṭṭhapessanti, ‘kinti anāgatā ca pesalā sabrahmacārī āgaccheyyuṃ, āgatā ca pesalā sabrahmacārī phāsuṃ vihareyyunti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (7)
dn16:1.6.18: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. [2.
dn16:1.7.1: aparepi bhikkhūnaṃ satta aparihāniyā dhammā:] apare pi vo bhikkhave, satta aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmīti.
dn16:1.7.2: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
dn16:1.7.4: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū na kammārāmā bhavissanti na kammaratā na kammārāmataṃ anuyuttā, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (1)
dn16:1.7.5: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū na bhassārāmā bhavissanti na bhassaratā na bhassārāmataṃ anuyuttā, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (2)
dn16:1.7.6: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū na niddārāmā bhavissanti na niddāratā na niddārāmataṃ anuyuttā, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (3)
dn16:1.7.7: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū na saṅgaṇikārāmā bhavissanti na saṅgaṇikaratā na saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyuttā, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (4)
dn16:1.7.8: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū na pāpicchā bhavissanti na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā, vuddhiyeva bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (5)
dn16:1.7.9: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū na pāpamittā bhavissanti na pāpasahāyā na pāpasampavaṅkā, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (6)
dn16:1.7.10: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū na oramattakena visesādhigamena antarā vosānaṃ āpajjissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (7)
dn16:1.8.1: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. [3.
dn16:1.8.2: aparepi satta aparihāniyā dhammā:] aparepi vo bhikkhave, satta aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī ti. ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca:
dn16:1.8.3: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhā bhavissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni. yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū
dn16:1.8.9: paññavanto bhavissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
dn16:1.8.10: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandissanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni. [4.
dn16:1.8.11: aparepi satta aparihāniyā dhammā:] aparepi vo bhikkhave, satta aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī ti.
dn16:1.8.12: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
dn16:1.9.7: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāvessanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
dn16:1.10.1: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni. [5.
dn16:1.10.2: aparepi satta aparihāniyā dhammā:] aparepi vo bhikkhave, satta aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī’ti.
dn16:1.10.3: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
dn16:1.10.11: nirodhasaññaṃ bhāvessanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni:
dn16:1.10.12: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni. [6. aparepi
dn16:1.11.1: cha aparihāniyā dhammā:] apare bhikkhave, cha aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī’ti.
dn16:1.11.2: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
dn16:1.11.4: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpessanti sabrahmacārīsu āvi ceva raho ca, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni. (1)
dn16:1.11.5: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū mettaṃ vacīkammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpessanti sabrahmacārīsu …pe…
dn16:1.11.6: mettaṃ manokammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpessanti sabrahmacārīsu āvī ceva raho ca, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni. (2-3)
dn16:1.11.7: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū ye te lābhā dhammikā dhammaladdhā antamaso pattapariyāpannamattampi, tathārūpehi lābhehi appaṭivibhattabhogī bhavissanti sīlavantehi sabrahmacārīhi sādhāraṇabhogī, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni. (4)
dn16:1.11.8: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū yāni tāni sīlāni akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni, tathārūpesu sīlesu sīlasāmaññagatā viharissanti sabrahmacārīhi āvī ceva raho ca, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni. (5)
dn16:1.11.9: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ yāyaṃ diṭṭhi ariyā niyyānikā niyyāti takkarassa sammādukkhakkhayāya, tathārūpāya diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhisāmaññagatā viharissanti sabrahmacārīhi āvī ceva raho ca bhikkhave, vuddhiyeva bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni. (6)
dn16:1.11.10: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, ime cha aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca chasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī’ti.
dn16:1.12.1: [bhikkhūnaṃ dhammīkathā:] tatra sudaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharanto gijjhakūṭe pabbate etadeva bahulaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ karoti:
dn16:1.12.5: paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sammadeva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyathidaṃ:
dn16:1.13.1: atha kho bhagavā rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:1.13.3: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
dn16:1.13.4: atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena ambalaṭṭhikā tadavasari.
dn16:1.14.1: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ viharati rājāgārake.
dn16:1.14.2: tatrapi sudaṃ bhagavā ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ viharanto rājāgārake etadeva bahulaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ karoti:
dn16:1.14.6: paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sammadeva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyathidaṃ:
dn16:1.15.1: atha kho bhagavā ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:1.15.3: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
dn16:1.15.4: atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena nālandā tadavasari.
dn16:1.15.5: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā nālandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane. [sāriputta sīhanādo.]
dn16:1.16.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:1.16.3: na cāhu na ca bhavissati na cetarahi vijjati añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo’bhiññataro yadidaṃ sambodhiyanti.”
dn16:1.16.4: uḷārā kho te ayaṃ sāriputta, āsabhī vācā bhāsitā, ekaṃso gahito, sīhanādo nadito:
dn16:1.16.6: na cāhu na ca bhavissati na cetarahi vijjati añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo’bhiññataro yadidaṃ sambodhiyanti.”
dn16:1.16.7: kinte sāriputta, ye te ahesuṃ. atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, sabbe te bhagavanto cetasā ceto paricca viditā:
dn16:1.16.8: evaṃsīlā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃdhammā - evaṃpaññā - evaṃvihārī - evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pī ti?
dn16:1.16.10: kimpana te sāriputta, ye te bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, sabbe te bhagavanto cetasā ceto paricca viditā:
dn16:1.16.11: evaṃsīlā te bhagavanto bhavissanti itipi, evaṃdhammā - evampaññā - evaṃvihārī - evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto bhavissanti iti pī ti?
dn16:1.16.13: kimpana te sāriputta, ahaṃ etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho cetasā ceto paricca vidito:
dn16:1.16.14: evaṃsīlo bhagavā iti pi, evaṃdhammo - evaṃpañño - evaṃvihārī - evaṃvimutto bhagavā iti pī ti?
dn16:1.16.16: ettha hi te sāriputta, atītānāgatapaccuppannesu arahantesu sammāsambuddhesu cetopariyañāṇaṃ natthi.
dn16:1.16.17: atha kiñcarahi te ayaṃ sāriputta, uḷārā āsabhī vācā bhāsitā, ekaṃso gahito, sīhanādo nadito:
dn16:1.16.18: ‘evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ bhante, bhagavati na cāhu na ca bhavissati na cetarahi vijjati añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo’bhiññataro yadidaṃ sambodhiyanti?”
dn16:1.17.1: na kho panetaṃ bhante, atītānāgatapaccuppannesu arahantesu sammāsambuddhesu cetopariyañāṇaṃ atthi.
dn16:1.17.2: api ca kho me bhante dhammanvayo vidito:
dn16:1.17.3: seyyathāpi bhante, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷhuddāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ ekadvāraṃ,
dn16:1.17.4: tatrassa dovāriko paṇḍito byatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā.
dn16:1.17.5: so tassa nagarassa sāmantā anupariyāyapathaṃ anukkamamāno na passeyya pākārasandhiṃ vā pākāravivaraṃ vā antamaso biḷāranissakkanamattampi,
dn16:1.17.7: ye keci oḷārikā pāṇā imaṃ nagaraṃ pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā sabbe te iminā’va dvārena pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā’ti,
dn16:1.17.8: evameva kho me bhante, dhammanvayo vidito:
dn16:1.17.9: ye te bhante, ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, sabbe te bhagavanto pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe, catusu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacittā, sattasambojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhiṃsu,
dn16:1.17.10: yepi te bhante, bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddho, sabbe te bhagavanto pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe, catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacittā, sattasambojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhissanti,
dn16:1.17.11: bhagavā’pi bhante, etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe, catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacitto, sattasambojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho’ti,
dn16:1.18.1: tatrapi sudaṃ bhagavā nālandāyaṃ viharanto pāvārikambavane etadeva bahulaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ karoti:
dn16:1.18.5: paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sammadeva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyathidaṃ:
dn16:1.19.1: atha kho bhagavā nālandāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:1.19.3: ‘evaṃ bhanteti’ kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
dn16:1.19.4: atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena pāṭaligāmo tadavasari.
dn16:1.20.1: assosuṃ kho pāṭaligāmiyā upāsakā ‘bhagavā kira pāṭaligāmaṃ anuppatto ti,
dn16:1.20.2: atha kho pāṭaligāmiyā upāsakā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho pāṭaligāmiyā upāsakā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn16:1.21.1: atha kho pāṭaligāmiyā upāsakā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena āvasathāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā sabbasanthariṃ āvasathāgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññāpetvā udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhapetvā telappadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho pāṭaligāmiyā upāsakā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn16:1.21.2: sabbasattharisanthataṃ bhante āvasathāgāraṃ, āsanāni paññattāni, udakamaṇiko patiṭṭhāpito, telappadīpo āropito.
dn16:1.21.3: yassa’dāni bhante, bhagavā kālaṃ maññatī ti.
dn16:1.22.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena āvasathāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā āvasathāgāraṃ pavisitvā majjhimaṃ thambhaṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi.
dn16:1.22.2: bhikkhusaṅghopi kho pāde pakkhāletvā āvasathāgāraṃ pavisitvā pacchimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi bhagavantaṃ yeva purakkhatvā.
dn16:1.22.3: pāṭaligāmiyā pi kho upāsakā pāde pakkhāletvā āvasathāgāraṃ pavisitvā puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya pacchimābhimukhā nisīdiṃsu bhagavantaṃ yeva purakkhatvā.
dn16:1.23.1: [pāṭaliyāgāmiyānaṃ upāsakānaṃ ovādo:] atha kho bhagavā pāṭaligāmiye upāsake āmantesi.
dn16:1.23.4: idha gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno pamādādhikaraṇaṃ mahatiṃ bhogajāniṃ nigacchati.
dn16:1.23.5: ayaṃ paṭhamo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlaṃ vipattiyā.
dn16:1.23.6: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, dussīlassa sīlavipannassa pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati.
dn16:1.23.8: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, avisārado upasaṅkamati maṅkubhūto.
dn16:1.23.10: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno sammūḷho kālaṃ karoti.
dn16:1.23.12: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
dn16:1.23.14: ime kho gahapatayo, pañca ādīnavā dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
dn16:1.24.3: idha gahapatayo, sīlavā sīlasampanno appamādādhikaraṇaṃ mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ adhigacchati.
dn16:1.24.5: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, sīlavato sīlasampannassa kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati.
dn16:1.24.7: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, sīlavā sīlasampannā yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto.
dn16:1.24.9: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, sīlavā sīlasampanno asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti.
dn16:1.24.11: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, sīlavā sīlasampanno kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
dn16:1.24.13: “ime kho gahapatayo, pañca ānisaṃsā sīlavato sīlasampadāyā”ti.
dn16:1.25.1: atha kho bhagavā pāṭaligāmiye upāsake bahudeva rattiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uyyojesi
dn16:1.25.2: “abhikkantā kho gahapatayo ratti, yassa’dāni tumhe kālaṃ maññathā”ti.
dn16:1.25.3: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho pāṭaligāmiyā upāsakā bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
dn16:1.25.4: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantesu pāṭaligāmiyesu upāsakesu suññāgāraṃ pāvisi. [pāṭalīnagaramāpanaṃ]
dn16:1.26.1: tena kho pana samayena sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāya.
dn16:1.26.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā devatāyo sahassasahasseva pāṭaligāme vatthūni parigaṇhanti.
dn16:1.26.3: yasmiṃ padese mahesakkhā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, mahesakkhānaṃ tattha raññaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
dn16:1.27.1: yasmiṃ padese majjhimā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, majjhimānaṃ tattha raññaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
dn16:1.27.2: yasmiṃ padese nīcā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, nīcānaṃ tattha raññaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
dn16:1.27.3: addasā kho bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena tā devatāye sahassasahasseva pāṭaligāme vatthūni parigaṇhantiyo.
dn16:1.27.4: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:1.27.5: konu kho ānanda, pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpentī?ti
dn16:1.27.6: “sunīdhavassakārā bhante, magadhamahāmattā pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāyā”ti.
dn16:1.28.1: seyyathāpi ānanda, devehi tāvatiṃsehi saddhiṃ mantetvā
dn16:1.28.2: evameva kho ānanda, sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāya.
dn16:1.28.3: idhāhaṃ ānanda, addasaṃ dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena sambahulā devatāyo sahassasahasseva pāṭaligāme vatthūni parigaṇhantiyo.
dn16:1.28.4: yasmiṃ ānanda, padese mahesakkhā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, mahesakkhānaṃ tattha raññaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
dn16:1.28.5: yasmiṃ padese majjhimā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, majjhimānaṃ tattha raññaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
dn16:1.28.6: yasmiṃ padese nīcā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, nīcānaṃ tattha raññaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
dn16:1.28.7: yāvatā ānanda, ariyaṃ āyatanaṃ yāvatā vaṇippatho idaṃ agganagaraṃ bhavissati pāṭaliputtaṃ puṭabhedanaṃ.
dn16:1.28.8: pāṭaliputtassa kho ānanda, tayo antarāyā bhavissanti:
dn16:1.28.9: aggito vā udakato vā mithubhedā vāti.
dn16:1.29.1: atha kho sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
dn16:1.29.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn16:1.29.3: “adhivāsetu no bhavaṃ gotamo ajjatanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
dn16:1.30.1: atha kho sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā yena sako āvasatho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā sake āvasathe paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesuṃ.
dn16:1.30.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena sunīdhavassakārānaṃ magadhamahāmattānaṃ āvasatho tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn16:1.30.4: atha kho sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesuṃ sampavāresuṃ.
dn16:1.30.5: atha kho sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
dn16:1.31.1: ekamantaṃ nisinne kho sunīdhavassakāre magadhamahāmatte bhagavā imāhi gāthāhi anumodi:
dn16:1.31.14: atha kho bhagavā sunīdhavassakāre magadhamahāmatte imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
dn16:1.32.1: tena kho pana samayena sunīdhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddhā honti.
dn16:1.32.2: ‘yenajja samaṇo gotamo dvārena nikkhamissati, taṃ gotamadvāraṃ nāma bhavissati.
dn16:1.32.3: yena titthena gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ tarissati, taṃ gotamatitthaṃ nāma bhavissatī’ti.
dn16:1.32.4: atha kho bhagavā yena dvārena nikkhami, taṃ gotamadvāraṃ nāma ahosi.
dn16:1.32.5: atha kho bhagavā yena gaṅgā nadī tenupasaṅkami.
dn16:1.33.1: tena kho pana samayena gaṅgā nadī pūrā hoti samātittikā kākapeyyā.
dn16:1.33.2: appekacce manussā nāvaṃ pariyesanti, appekacce uḷumpaṃ pariyesanti, appekacce kullaṃ bandhanti orā pāraṃ gantukāmā.
dn16:1.33.3: atha kho bhagavā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva gaṅgāya nadiyā orimatīre antarahito pārimatīre paccuṭṭhāsi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
dn16:1.34.1: addasā kho bhagavā te manusse appekacce nāvaṃ pariyesante appekacce uḷumpaṃ pariyesante, appekacce kullaṃ bandhante orā pāraṃ gantukāme.
dn16:1.34.2: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
dn16:2.1.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:2.1.3: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti. kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
dn16:2.1.4: atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena koṭigāmo tadavasari.
dn16:2.2.2: catunnaṃ bhikkhave, ariyasaccānaṃ ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evamidaṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañceva tumhākañca.
dn16:2.2.4: dukkhassa bhikkhave, ariyasaccassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evamidaṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañceva tumhākañca.
dn16:2.2.5: dukkhasamudayassa bhikkhave, ariyasaccassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evamidaṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañceva tumhākañca.
dn16:2.2.6: dukkhanirodhassa bhikkhave, ariyasaccassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evamidaṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañceva tumhākañca.
dn16:2.2.7: dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya bhikkhave, ariyasaccassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evamidaṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañceva tumhākañca.
dn16:2.2.8: tayidaṃ bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ. dukkhanirodho ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ. dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ. ucchinnā bhavataṇhā, khīṇā bhavanetti. natthidāni punabbhavo’ti.
dn16:2.3.2: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
dn16:2.4.1: tatrapi sudaṃ bhagavā koṭigāme viharanto etadeva bahulaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ karoti:
dn16:2.4.5: paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sammadeva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyathidaṃ:
dn16:2.5.1: atha kho bhagavā koṭigāme yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
dn16:2.5.3: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
dn16:2.5.4: atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena nādikā tadavasari.
dn16:2.5.5: tatrapi sudaṃ bhagavā nādike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
dn16:2.6.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:2.6.2: sāḷho nāma bhante, bhikkhu nādike kālakato. tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo?
dn16:2.6.3: nandā nāma bhante, bhikkhunī nādike kālakatā. tassā kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo?
dn16:2.6.4: sudatto nāma bhante, upāsako nādike kālakato. tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo?
dn16:2.6.5: sujātā nāma bhante, upāsikā nādike kālakatā. tassā kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo?
dn16:2.6.6: kakudhonāma bhante, upāsako nādike kālakato. tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo?
dn16:2.6.13: subhaddo nāma bhante, upāsako nādike kālakato. tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo?ti.
dn16:2.7.1: sāḷho ānanda, bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
dn16:2.7.2: nandā ānanda, bhikkhunī pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyinī anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā.
dn16:2.7.3: sudatto ānanda, upāsako tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissati.
dn16:2.7.4: sujātā ānanda, upāsikā tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā.
dn16:2.7.5: kakudho nāma ānanda, upāsako pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
dn16:2.7.12: subhaddo ānanda, upāsako pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
dn16:2.7.13: paropaññāsaṃ ānanda, nādike upāsakā kālakatā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyino anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā.
dn16:2.7.14: sādhikā navuti ānanda, nādike upāsakā kālakatā tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissanti.
dn16:2.7.15: sātirekāni ānanda, pañca satāni nādike upāsakā kālakatā, tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā.
dn16:2.8.1: anacchariyaṃ kho panetaṃ ānanda, yaṃ manussabhūto kālaṃkareyya.
dn16:2.8.2: tasmiñce kālakate tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ pucchissatha, vihesā cesā ānanda, tathāgatassa.
dn16:2.8.3: tasmātihānanda, dhammādāsaṃ nāma dhammapariyāyaṃ desessāmi yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanā’va attānaṃ byākareyya:
dn16:2.8.4: ‘khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpanno’hamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’ti.
dn16:2.9.1: katamo ca so ānanda, dhammādāso dhammapariyāyo yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanā’va attānaṃ byākareyya:
dn16:2.9.2: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpanno’hamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’ti:
dn16:2.9.3: idhānanda, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
dn16:2.9.4: “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
dn16:2.9.6: “svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī”ti.
dn16:2.9.8: “supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujupaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ñāyapaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, sāmīcipaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni, aṭṭha purisapuggalā. esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo, pāhuneyyo, dakkhiṇeyyo, añjalikaraṇīyo, anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti.
dn16:2.9.9: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi acchiddehi asabalehi akammāsehi bhujissehi viññuppasatthehi aparāmaṭṭhehi samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
dn16:2.9.10: ayaṃ kho so ānanda, dhammādāso dhammapariyāyo yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanā’va attānaṃ byākareyya
dn16:2.9.11: ‘khīṇanirayo’mhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto. sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’ti.
dn16:2.10.1: tatra pi sudaṃ bhagavā nādike viharanto giñjakāvasathe etadeva bahulaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ karoti:
dn16:2.10.5: paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sammadeva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyathidaṃ:
dn16:2.11.1: [ambapālivane satipaṭṭhāna desanā] atha kho bhagavā nādike yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:2.11.3: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
dn16:2.11.4: atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena vesālī tadavasari.
dn16:2.11.5: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati ambapālivane.
dn16:2.12.5: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
dn16:2.12.6: vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
dn16:2.12.7: citte cittānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
dn16:2.12.8: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
dn16:2.12.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu sato hoti.
dn16:2.13.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti. ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti. sammiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti. saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti. asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti. uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti. gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
dn16:2.13.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu sampajāno hoti.
dn16:2.14.1: assosi kho ambapālī gaṇikā ‘bhagavā kira vesāliṃ anuppatto vesāliyaṃ viharati mayhaṃ ambavane’ti.
dn16:2.14.2: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojāpetvā, bhaddaṃ bhaddaṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā, bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi vesāliyā niyyāsi. yena sako ārāmo tena pāyāsi.
dn16:2.14.3: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattikā’va yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn16:2.14.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ambapāliṃ gaṇikaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
dn16:2.14.5: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:2.14.6: ‘adhivāsetu me bhante, bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā’ti.
dn16:2.14.8: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
dn16:2.15.1: assosuṃ kho vesālikā licchavī ‘bhagavā kira vesāliṃ anuppatto vesāliyaṃ viharati ambapālivane’ti.
dn16:2.15.2: atha kho te licchavī bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojāpetvā, bhaddaṃ bhaddaṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā, bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi vesāliyā nīyiṃsu.
dn16:2.15.3: tatra ekacce licchavī nīlā honti nīlavaṇṇā nīlavatthā nīlālaṅkārā, ekacce licchavī pītā honti pītavaṇṇā pītavatthā pītālaṅkārā, ekacce licchavī lohitā honti lohitavaṇṇā lohitavatthā lohitālaṅkārā, ekacce licchavī odātā honti odātavaṇṇā odātavatthā odātālaṅkārā.
dn16:2.16.1: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā daharānaṃ daharānaṃ licchavīnaṃ akkhena akkhaṃ cakkena cakkaṃ yugena yugaṃ pativaṭṭesi.
dn16:2.16.2: atha kho te licchavī ambapāliṃ gaṇikaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn16:2.16.3: ‘kiñje, ambapāli, daharānaṃ daharānaṃ licchavīnaṃ akkhena akkhaṃ cakkena cakkaṃ yugena yugaṃ paṭivaṭṭesī?’ti.
dn16:2.16.4: ‘tathā hi pana me ayyaputtā, bhagavā nimantito svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā’ti.
dn16:2.16.6: ‘sace’pi me ayyaputtā vesāliṃ sāhāraṃ dassatha, evamahaṃ taṃ bhattaṃ na dassāmī’ti.
dn16:2.16.7: atha kho te licchavī aṅguliṃ poṭhesuṃ
dn16:2.16.8: ‘jitamhā vata bho ambakāya, jitamhā vata bho ambakāyā’ti.
dn16:2.16.9: atha kho te licchavī yena ambapālivanaṃ tena pāyiṃsu.
dn16:2.17.1: addasā kho bhagavā te licchavī dūrato’va āgacchante.
dn16:2.17.3: ‘yesaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ devā tāvatiṃsā adiṭṭhā, oloketha bhikkhave, licchavīparisaṃ,
dn16:2.18.1: atha kho te licchavī yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā, pattikā’va yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
dn16:2.18.2: ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te licchavī bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
dn16:2.18.3: atha kho te licchavī bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn16:2.18.4: ‘adhivāsetu no bhante, bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā’ti.
dn16:2.18.5: atha kho bhagavā te licchavī etadavoca.
dn16:2.18.6: ‘adhivutthaṃ kho me licchavī, svātanāya ambapāliyā gaṇikāya bhattanti.’
dn16:2.18.7: atha kho te licchavī aṅguliṃ poṭhesuṃ:
dn16:2.18.8: ‘jitamhā vata bho ambakāya. jitamhā vata bho ambakāyā ti.
dn16:2.18.9: atha kho te licchavī bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
dn16:2.19.1: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā tassā rattiyā accayena sake ārāme paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
dn16:2.19.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena ambapāliyā gaṇikāya nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn16:2.19.4: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
dn16:2.19.5: atha kho ambapālī gaṇikā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn16:2.19.6: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho ambapālī gaṇikā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:2.19.9: atha kho bhagavā ambapāliṃ gaṇikaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
dn16:2.20.1: tatrapi sudaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharanto ambapālivane etadeva bahulaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ karoti:
dn16:2.20.5: paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sammadeva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyathidaṃ:
dn16:2.20.6: kāmāsavā bhavāsavā avijjāsavā”ti. [beluvagāme jīvita saṅkhāra - adhiṭṭhānaṃ]
dn16:2.21.1: atha kho bhagavā ambapālivane yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:2.21.3: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
dn16:2.21.4: atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena beluvagāmako tadavasari.
dn16:2.22.2: ‘etha tumhe bhikkhave, samantā vesāliṃ yathāmittaṃ yathāsandiṭṭhaṃ yathāsambhattaṃ vassaṃ upetha.
dn16:2.22.3: ahaṃ pana idheva beluvagāmake vassaṃ upagacchāmī’ti.
dn16:2.22.4: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā samantā vesāliṃ yathāmittaṃ yathāsandiṭṭhaṃ yathāsambhattaṃ vassaṃ upagacchiṃsu.
dn16:2.22.5: bhagavā pana tattheva beluvagāmake vassaṃ upagañchi.
dn16:2.23.1: atha kho bhagavato vassūpagatassa kharo ābādho uppajji. bāḷhā vedanā vattanti māraṇantikā.
dn16:2.23.2: tā sudaṃ bhagavā sato sampajāno adhivāseti avihaññamāno.
dn16:2.23.4: ‘na kho metaṃ patirūpaṃ yo’haṃ anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parinibbāyeyyaṃ.
dn16:2.23.5: yannūnāhaṃ imaṃ ābādhaṃ viriyena paṭippanāmetvā jīvitasaṅkhāraṃ adhiṭṭhāya vihareyya’nti.
dn16:2.24.1: atha kho bhagavā taṃ ābādhaṃ viriyena paṭippanāmetvā jīvitasaṅkhāraṃ adhiṭṭhāya vihāsi.
dn16:2.24.2: atha kho bhagavato so ābādho paṭippassambhi.
dn16:2.24.3: atha kho bhagavā gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā vihārā nikkhamma vihārapacchāyāyaṃ paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn16:2.24.4: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:2.24.5: “diṭṭho me bhante bhagavato phāsu. diṭṭhaṃ me bhante bhagavato khamanīyaṃ. api ca me bhante madhurakajāto viya kāyo. disā’pi me na pakkhāyanti, dhammā’pi maṃ nappaṭibhanti bhagavato gelaññena.
dn16:2.24.6: api ca me bhante ahosi kāci deva assāsamattā
dn16:2.24.7: ‘na tāva bhagavā parinibbāyissati, na yāva bhagavā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ārabbha kiñcideva udāharatī”ti.
dn16:2.25.2: desito ānanda, mayā dhammo anantaraṃ abāhiraṃ karitvā.
dn16:2.25.5: ‘ahaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharissāmī’ti vā, mamuddesiko bhikkhusaṅgho’ti vā, so nūna ānanda, bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ārabbha kiñcideva udāhareyya.
dn16:2.25.6: tathāgatassa kho ānanda, na evaṃ hoti:
dn16:2.25.7: ‘ahaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharissāmī’ti vā mamuddesiko bhikkhusaṅgho’ti vā.
dn16:2.25.8: sa kiṃ ānanda, tathāgato bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ārabbha kiñcideva udāharissati?
dn16:2.25.9: ahaṃ kho panānanda, etarahi jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto.
dn16:2.25.12: evameva kho ānanda, vekkhamissakena maññe tathāgatassa kāyo yāpeti.
dn16:2.25.13: yasmiṃ ānanda, samaye tathāgato sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā ekaccānaṃ vedanānaṃ nirodhā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati, phāsutaro ānanda, tasmiṃ samaye tathāgatassa kāyo hoti.
dn16:2.26.1: tasmātihānanda, attadīpā viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā.
dn16:2.26.2: kathañca ānanda, bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo, dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo:
dn16:2.26.3: idhānanda bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati atāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
dn16:2.26.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
dn16:2.26.7: evaṃ kho ānanda, bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo, dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo.
dn16:2.26.8: ye hi keci ānanda, etarahi vā mamaṃ vā accayena attadīpā viharissanti attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā. dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, tamatagge me te ānanda, bhikkhū bhavissanti ye keci sikkhākāmā’ti.
dn16:3.1.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
dn16:3.1.2: vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:3.1.5: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā nisīdanaṃ ādāya bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
dn16:3.2.1: atha kho bhagavā yena cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn16:3.2.2: āyasmā pi kho ānando bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn16:3.2.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
dn16:3.2.4: “ramaṇīyā ānanda vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sattamba cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ.
dn16:3.3.1: yassa kassaci ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, so ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā.
dn16:3.3.2: tathāgatassa kho pana ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā. so ākaṅkhamāno ānanda, tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā”ti.
dn16:3.4.1: evaṃ kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ.
dn16:3.4.3: “tiṭṭhatu bhante bhagavā kappaṃ, tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti” yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
dn16:3.5.2: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:3.5.3: “ramaṇīyā ānanda vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sattambaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ.
dn16:3.5.4: yassa kassaci ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, so ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā.
dn16:3.5.5: tathāgatassa kho ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā. so ākaṅkhamāno ānanda, tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā”ti.
dn16:3.5.6: evampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ.
dn16:3.5.8: “tiṭṭhatu bhante bhagavā kappaṃ, tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti” yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
dn16:3.6.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:3.6.4: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
dn16:3.7.1: atha kho māro pāpimā acirapakkante āyasmante ānande yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho māro pāpimā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:3.7.2: “parinibbātu’dāni bhante bhagavā. parinibbātu sugato. parinibbānakālo’dāni bhante bhagavato.
dn16:3.7.4: ‘na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhū nā sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessantī’ti.
dn16:3.8.1: etarahi kho pana bhante, bhikkhū bhagavato sāvakaṃ viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
dn16:3.8.2: parinibbātu’dāni bhante bhagavā. parinibbātu sugato. parinibbānakālo’dāni bhante bhagavato.”
dn16:3.8.4: ‘na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessantī’ti.
dn16:3.8.5: etarahi kho pana bhante, bhikkhuniyo bhagavato sāvikā viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
dn16:3.8.6: parinibbātu’dāni bhante bhagavā. parinibbātu sugato. parinibbānakālo’dāni bhante bhagavato.”
dn16:3.8.8: ‘na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me upāsakā na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappaṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessantī’ti.
dn16:3.8.9: etarahi kho pana bhante, upāsakā bhagavato sāvakā viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
dn16:3.8.10: parinibbātu’dāni bhante, bhagavā. parinibbātu sugato. parinibbānakālo’dāni bhante bhagavato.”
dn16:3.8.12: ‘na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me upāsikā na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappaṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessantī’ti.
dn16:3.8.13: etarahi kho pana bhante, upāsikā bhagavato sāvikā viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desentī.
dn16:3.8.14: parinibbātu’dāni bhante bhagavā. parinibbātu sugato. parinibbānakālo’dāni bhante bhagavato.”
dn16:3.8.15: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante, bhagavatā vācā:
dn16:3.8.16: ‘na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na iddhaṃ ceva bhavissati phītañca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ, yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitanti’.
dn16:3.8.17: etarahi kho pana bhante, bhagavato brahmacariyaṃ iddhañceva phītañca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ.
dn16:3.8.18: parinibbātu’dāni bhante bhagavā. parinibbātu sugato. parinibbānakālo’dāni bhante bhagavato”ti.
dn16:3.9.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:3.9.2: appossukke tvaṃ pāpima hohi. na ciraṃ tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:3.9.3: ito tiṇṇaṃ māsānaṃ accayena tathāgato parinibbāyissatī”ti.
dn16:3.10.1: atha kho bhagavā cāpāle cetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajī.
dn16:3.10.2: ossaṭṭhe ca bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso. devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
dn16:3.10.3: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
dn16:3.11.2: acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho. mahā vatāyaṃ bhūmicālo,
dn16:3.11.3: sumahā vatāyaṃ bhūmicālo, bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso. devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
dn16:3.11.4: ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyā’ti.
dn16:3.12.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
dn16:3.12.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:3.12.6: sumahā vatāyaṃ bhante bhūmicālo, bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso. devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
dn16:3.12.7: ko nu kho bhante, hetu ko paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyā?”ti.
dn16:3.13.1: aṭṭha kho ime ānanda, hetū aṭṭha paccayā mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
dn16:3.13.3: ayaṃ ānanda, mahāpaṭhavi udake patiṭṭhitā. udakaṃ vāte patiṭṭhitaṃ. vāto ākāsaṭṭho hoti. hoti kho so ānanda samayo yaṃ mahāvātā vāyanti, mahāvātā vāyantā udakaṃ kampenti, udakaṃ kampitaṃ paṭhaviṃ kampeti.
dn16:3.13.4: ayaṃ paṭhamo hetu paṭhamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. (1)
dn16:3.14.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda, samaṇo vā hoti brāhmaṇo vā iddhimā cetovasippatto, devo vā mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo, tassa parittā paṭhavisaññā bhāvitā hoti, appamāṇā āposaññā. so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ kampeti saṃkampeti sampakampeti sampavedheti.
dn16:3.14.2: ayaṃ dutiyo hetu dutiyo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. (2)
dn16:3.15.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda, yadā bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā sato sampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkamati, tadā’yaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati sampavedhati.
dn16:3.15.2: ayaṃ tatiyo hetu tatiyo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. (3)
dn16:3.16.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda, yadā bodhisatto sato sampajāno mātukucchismiṃ nikkhamati, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati sampavedhati.
dn16:3.16.2: ayaṃ catuttho hetu catuttho paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. (4)
dn16:3.17.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda, yadā tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṅkampati sampakampati sampavedhati.
dn16:3.17.2: ayaṃ pañcamo hetu pañcamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. (5)
dn16:3.18.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda, yadā tathāgato anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavatteti, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati sampavedhati.
dn16:3.18.2: ayaṃ chaṭṭho hetu chaṭṭho paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. (6)
dn16:3.19.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda, yadā tathāgato sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajati, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati sampavedhati.
dn16:3.19.2: ayaṃ sattamo hetu sattamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. (7)
dn16:3.20.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda, yadā tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyati, tadā’yaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati sampavedhati.
dn16:3.20.2: ayaṃ aṭṭhamo hetu aṭṭhamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. (8)
dn16:3.20.3: ime kho ānanda, aṭṭha hetū aṭṭha paccayā mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyā’ti.
dn16:3.21.3: khattiyaparisā brāhmaṇaparisā gahapatiparisā samaṇaparisā cātummahārājikaparisā tāvatiṃsaparisā māraparisā brahmaparisā.

dn16:3.22.2: tatrāpi mayā sannisinnapubbañceva sallapitapubbañca sākacchā ca samāpajjitapubbā.

dn16:3.34.2: atha kho ānanda, māro pāpimā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho ānanda, māro pāpimā maṃ etadavoca:

dn16:3.34.4: evaṃ vutto’haṃ ānanda, māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etadavocaṃ:
dn16:3.35.1: “na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhū na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññāpessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessanti.
dn16:3.35.2: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi. yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññāpessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessanti.
dn16:3.35.3: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me upāsakā na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññāpessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessanti.
dn16:3.35.4: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi yāva me upāsikā na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīpaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññāpessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessanti.

dn16:3.38.4: mā tathāgataṃ yāci. akālo’dāni ānanda, tathāgataṃ yācanāyā’ti.
dn16:3.39.2: tatiyampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:

dn16:3.40.7: ‘tiṭṭhatu bhante bhagavā kappaṃ, tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussāna’nti.

dn16:3.49.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ yena mahāvanaṃ kūṭāgārasālā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:3.49.2: gaccha tvaṃ ānanda, yāvatikā bhikkhū vesāliṃ upanissāya viharanti, te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātehī”ti.
dn16:3.49.3: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā, yāvatikā bhikkhū vesāliṃ upanissāya viharanti, te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:3.49.4: “sannipātito bhante bhikkhusaṅgho, yassa’dāni bhante bhagavā kālaṃ maññatī”ti.
dn16:3.50.1: [brahmacariyaciraṭṭhitika - dhammadesanā] atha kho bhagavā yena upaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn16:3.50.3: “tasmātiha bhikkhave, ye te mayā dhammā abhiññā desitā, te vo sādhukaṃ uggahetvā āsevitabbā bhāvetabbā bahulīkātabbā yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ. tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
dn16:3.50.4: katame ca te bhikkhave, dhammā mayā abhiññā desitā, ye vo sādhukaṃ uggahetvā āsevitabbā bhāvetabbā bahulīkātabbā yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ. tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
dn16:3.50.5: seyyathidaṃ, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā, cattāro iddhipādā, pañcindriyāni, pañca balāni, satta bojjhaṅgā, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo.
dn16:3.51.1: ime kho bhikkhave, dhammā mayā abhiññā desitā. te vo sādhukaṃ uggahetvā āsevitabbā bhāvetabbā bahulīkātabbā yathāyidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti.”
dn16:3.51.6: ito tiṇṇaṃ māsānaṃ accayena tathāgato parinibbāyissatī”ti.
dn16:3.51.8: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā.
