dn16:4.12.1: tatrapi sudaṃ bhagavā bhoganagare viharanto ānande cetiye etadeva bahulaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ karoti:
dn16:4.12.5: paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sammadeva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyathidaṃ:
dn16:4.13.1: atha kho bhagavā bhoganagare yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.13.4: atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena pāvā tadavasari.
dn16:4.13.5: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā pāvāyaṃ viharati cundassa kammāraputtassa ambavane.
dn16:4.14.1: assosi kho cundo kammāraputto: ‘bhagavā kira pāvaṃ anuppatto, pāvāyaṃ viharati mayhaṃ ambavane’ti.
dn16:4.14.2: atha kho cundo kammāraputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn16:4.14.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho cundaṃ kammāraputtaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
dn16:4.14.4: atha kho cundo kammāraputto bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:4.15.1: ‘adhivāsetu me bhante, bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā’ti.
dn16:4.16.1: atha kho cundo kammāraputto bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
dn16:4.17.1: atha kho cundo kammāraputto tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā pahūtañca sūkaramaddavaṃ, bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
dn16:4.18.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena cundassa kammāraputtassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn16:4.18.2: nisajja kho bhagavā cundaṃ kammāraputtaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.18.3: ‘yante cunda, sūkaramaddavaṃ paṭiyattaṃ, tena maṃ parivisa.
dn16:4.18.4: yaṃ panaññaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyattaṃ, tena bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parivisā’ti.
dn16:4.18.5: ‘evambhante’ti kho cundo kammāraputto bhagavato paṭissutvā yaṃ ahosi sūkaramaddavaṃ paṭiyattaṃ, tena bhagavantaṃ parivisi.
dn16:4.18.6: yaṃ panaññaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyattaṃ, tena bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parivisi.
dn16:4.19.1: atha kho bhagavā cundaṃ kammāraputtaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.19.2: yante cunda, sūkaramaddavaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ, taṃ sobbhe nikhanāhi.
dn16:4.19.3: nāhaṃ taṃ cunda, passāmi sadevake loke samārake, sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yassa taṃ paribhuttaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya aññatra tathāgatassā’ti.
dn16:4.19.4: ‘evambhante’ti kho cundo kammāraputto bhagavato paṭissutvā, yaṃ ahosi sūkaramaddavaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ, taṃ sobbhe nikhaṇitvā, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami: upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn16:4.19.5: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho cundaṃ kammāraputtaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
dn16:4.20.1: [lohitapakkhandikā ābādho] atha kho bhagavato cundassa kammāraputtassa bhattaṃ bhuttāvissa kharo ābādho uppajji lohitapakkhandikā. pabāḷhā vedanā vattanti māraṇantikā.
dn16:4.20.2: tā sudaṃ bhagavā sato sampajāno adhivāsesi avihaññamāno.
dn16:4.20.3: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.21.1: atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma yenaññataraṃ rukkhamūlaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.21.2: “iṅgha me tvaṃ ānanda, catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññapehi. kilanto’smi ānanda, nisīdissāmī”ti.
dn16:4.21.3: ‘evambhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññapesi.
dn16:4.22.1: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.22.2: “iṅgha me tvaṃ ānanda, pānīyaṃ āhara, pipāsito’mhi ānanda, pivissāmī’ti.
dn16:4.22.3: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:4.22.4: “idāni bhante, pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni atikkantāni. taṃ cakkacchinnaṃ udakaṃ parittaṃ luḷitaṃ āvilaṃ sandati.
dn16:4.22.5: ayaṃ bhante, kakutthā nadī avidūre acchodakā sātodakā sītodakā setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā.
dn16:4.22.6: ettha bhagavā pānīyañca pivissati, gattāni ca sītīkarissatīti”.
dn16:4.23.1: dutiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.23.2: ‘iṅgha me tvaṃ ānanda, pānīyaṃ āhara, pipāsito’smi ānanda, pivissāmī’ti.
dn16:4.23.3: dutiyampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:4.23.4: “idāni bhante, pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni atikkantāni. taṃ cakkacchinnaṃ udakaṃ parittaṃ luḷitaṃ āvilaṃ sandati.
dn16:4.23.5: ayaṃ bhante kakutthā nadī avidūre acchodakā sātodakā sītodakā setakā suppatitthā ramaṇīyā.
dn16:4.23.6: ettha bhagavā pānīyañca pivissati, gattāni ca sītīkarissatī”ti.
dn16:4.24.1: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.24.2: ‘iṅgha me tvaṃ ānanda, pānīyaṃ āhara, pipāsito’smi ānanda, pivissāmī”ti.
dn16:4.24.3: ‘evambhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā pattaṃ gahetvā yena sā nadikā tenupasaṅkami.
dn16:4.24.4: atha kho sā nadikā cakkacchinnā parittā luḷitā āvilā sandamānā āyasmante ānande upasaṅkamante acchā vippasannā anāvilā sandittha.
dn16:4.25.2: ‘acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho, tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā.
dn16:4.25.3: ayaṃ hi sā nadikā cakkacchinnā parittā luḷitā āvilā sandamānā mayi upasaṅkamante acchā vippasannā anāvilā sandatī’ti.
dn16:4.25.4: pattena pānīyaṃ ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:4.25.5: “acchariyaṃ bhante, abbhutaṃ bhante, tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā.
dn16:4.25.6: idāni sā bhante nadikā cakkacchinnā parittā luḷitā āvilā sandamānā mayi upasaṅkamante acchā vippasannā anāvilā sandittha.
dn16:4.25.7: pivatu bhagavā pānīyaṃ, pivatu sugato pānīyanti”.
dn16:4.26.1: tena kho pana samayena pukkuso mallaputto āḷārassa kālāmassa sāvako kusinārāya pāvaṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti.
dn16:4.26.2: addasā kho pukkuso mallaputto bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ.
dn16:4.26.3: disvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho pukkuso mallaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:4.26.4: “acchariyaṃ bhante, abbhutaṃ bhante, santena vata bhante, pabbajitā vihārena viharanti.
dn16:4.27.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhante, āḷāro kālāmo addhānamaggapaṭipanno maggā okkamma avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
dn16:4.27.2: atha kho bhante, pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ nissāya nissāya atikkamiṃsu.
dn16:4.27.3: atha kho bhante, aññataro puriso tassa sakaṭasatthassa piṭṭhito piṭṭhito āgacchanto yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:4.27.9: na kho ahaṃ āvuso, sutto ahosi’nti.
dn16:4.27.12: ‘so tvaṃ bhante, saññī samāno jāgaro pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni nissāya nissāya atikkamantāni neva addasa, na pana saddaṃ assosi.
dn16:4.27.13: apissu te bhante, saṅghāṭi rajena okiṇṇā?ti.
dn16:4.27.15: atha kho bhante, tassa purisassa etadahosi:
dn16:4.27.16: acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho, santena vata bho pabbajitā vihārena viharanti.
dn16:4.27.17: yatra hi nāma saññī samāno jāgaro pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni nissāya nissāya atikkamantāni neva dakkhiti, na pana saddaṃ sossatī’ti
dn16:4.27.18: āḷāre kālāme uḷāraṃ pasādaṃ paveditvā pakkāmī”ti.
dn16:4.28.2: katamannu kho dukkarataraṃ vā durabhisambhavataraṃ vā
dn16:4.28.3: yo saññī samāno jāgaro pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni nissāya nissāya atikkamantāni neva passeyya, na pana saddaṃ suṇeyya,
dn16:4.28.4: yo vā saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve galagalāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaṇiyā phalantiyā neva passeyya na pana saddaṃ suṇeyyā?ti.
dn16:4.29.1: “kiñhi bhante, karissanti pañca vā sakaṭasatāni cha vā sakaṭasatāni satta vā sakaṭasatāni aṭṭha vā sakaṭasatāni nava vā sakaṭasatāni sakaṭasahassaṃ vā sakaṭasatasahassaṃ vā.
dn16:4.29.2: atha kho etadeva dukkarataraṃ ceva durabhisambhavatarañca yo saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve galagalāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaṇiyā phalantiyā neva passeyya na pana saddaṃ suṇeyyā”ti.
dn16:4.30.1: ekamidāhaṃ pukkusa, samayaṃ ātumāyaṃ viharāmi bhūsāgāre.
dn16:4.30.2: tena kho pana samayena deve vassante deve galagalāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaṇiyā phalantiyā avidūre bhusāgārassa dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balivaddā.
dn16:4.30.3: atha kho pukkusa, ātumāya mahājanakāyo nikkhamitvā yena te dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattārā ca balivaddā, tenupasaṅkami.
dn16:4.31.1: tena kho panāhaṃ pukkusa, samayena bhusāgārā nikkhamitvā bhusāgāradvāre abbhokāse caṅkamāmi.
dn16:4.31.2: atha kho pukkusa, aññataro puriso tamhā mahājanakāyā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho ahaṃ pukkusa taṃ purisaṃ etadavocaṃ
dn16:4.32.2: idāni bhante, deve vassante deve galagalāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaṇiyā phalantiyā dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balivaddā.
dn16:4.32.14: ‘so tvaṃ bhante, saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve galagalāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaṇiyā phalantiyā neva addasa, na pana saddaṃ assosī?’ti.
dn16:4.33.1: atha kho pukkusa, tassa purisassa etadahosi.
dn16:4.33.2: ‘acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho, santena vata bho pabbajitā vihārena viharanti.
dn16:4.33.3: yatra hi nāma saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve galagalāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaṇiyā phalantiyā neva dakkhiti, na pana saddaṃ sossatī’ti
dn16:4.33.4: mayi uḷāraṃ pasādaṃ pavedetvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmī’ti.
dn16:4.34.1: evaṃ vutte pukkuso mallaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:4.34.2: ‘esāhaṃ bhante, yo me āḷāre kālāme pasādo, taṃ mahāvāte vā opunāmi, sīghasotāya vā nadiyā pavāhemi.
dn16:4.34.4: seyyathāpi bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, evameva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn16:4.34.5: esāhaṃ bhante, bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
dn16:4.34.6: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
dn16:4.35.1: atha kho pukkuso mallaputto aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi.
dn16:4.35.2: ‘iṅgha me tvaṃ bhaṇe siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugaṃ maṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ āhāra’ti.
dn16:4.35.3: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti so puriso pukkusassa mallaputtassa paṭissutvā taṃ siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugaṃ maṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ āhari.
dn16:4.35.4: atha kho pukkuso mallaputto taṃ siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugaṃ maṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ bhagavato upanāmesi
dn16:4.35.5: ‘idambhante siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugaṃ maṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ. tamme bhante bhagavā patigaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā’ti.
dn16:4.35.6: ‘tena hi pukkusa, ekena maṃ acchādehi ekena ānandanti’.
dn16:4.35.7: ‘evambhante’ti kho pukkuso mallaputto bhagavato paṭissutvā ekena bhagavantaṃ acchādesi ekena āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ.
dn16:4.36.1: atha kho bhagavā pukkusaṃ mallaputtaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi, samādapesi, samuttejesi, sampahaṃsesi.
dn16:4.36.2: atha kho pukkuso mallaputto bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
dn16:4.37.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando acirapakkante pukkuse mallaputte taṃ siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugaṃ maṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ bhagavato kāyaṃ upanāmesi.
dn16:4.37.2: taṃ bhagavato kāyaṃ upanāmitaṃ vītaccikaṃ viya khāyati.
dn16:4.37.3: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:4.37.4: ‘acchariyambhante, abbhutambhante, yāvaparisuddho bhante, tathāgatassa chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
dn16:4.37.5: idambhante siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugaṃ maṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ bhagavato upanāmitaṃ vītaccikaṃ viya khāyatī’ti.
dn16:4.37.6: “evametaṃ ānanda, dvīsu kho ānanda, kālesu ativiya tathāgatassa kāyo parisuddho hoti chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
dn16:4.38.2: yañca ānanda, rattiṃ tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati, yañca rattiṃ tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyati.
dn16:4.38.3: imesu kho ānanda, dvīsu kālesu ativiya tathāgatassa kāyo parisuddho hoti chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
dn16:4.38.4: ajja kho panānanda, rattiyā pacchime yāme kusinārāyaṃ upavattane mallānaṃ sālavane antarena yamakasālānaṃ tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:4.39.1: [ambavanūpagamanaṃ] atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena kakutthā nadī tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā kakutthaṃ nadiṃ ajjhogāhetvā nhātvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā yena ambavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami.
dn16:4.39.3: ‘iṅgha me cundaka, catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññāpehi. kilanto’smi cundaka, nipajjissāmī’ti.
dn16:4.40.1: ‘evambhante’ti kho āyasmā cundako bhagavato paṭissutvā catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññāpesi.
dn16:4.40.2: atha kho bhagavā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasi karitvā.
dn16:4.40.3: āyasmā pana cundako tattheva bhagavato purato nisīdi.
dn16:4.42.1: [dve piṇḍapātā samaphalā] atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi.
dn16:4.42.2: “siyā kho panānanda, cundassa kammāraputtassa koci vippaṭisāraṃ upadaheyya”
dn16:4.42.3: ‘tassa te āvuso cunda, alābhā, tassa te dulladdhaṃ, yassa te tathāgato pacchimaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā parinibbuto’ti.
dn16:4.42.5: tassa te āvuso lābhā, tassa te suladdhaṃ,
dn16:4.42.6: yassa te tathāgato pacchimaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā parinibbuto.
dn16:4.42.7: sammukhā metaṃ āvuso cunda, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
dn16:4.42.8: ‘dve’me piṇḍapātā samaphalā samavipākā ativiya aññehi piṇḍapātehi mahapphalatarā ca mahānisaṃsatarā ca.
dn16:4.42.10: yañca piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhatī, yañca piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyati,
dn16:4.42.11: ime dve piṇḍapātā samaphalā samavipākā ativiya aññehi piṇḍapātehi mahapphalatarā ca mahānisaṃsatarā ca.
dn16:4.42.12: āyusaṃvattanikaṃ panāyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, sukhasaṃvattanikaṃ panāyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, vaṇṇasaṃvattanikaṃ panāyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, yasasaṃvattanikaṃ panāyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, saggasaṃvattanikaṃ panāyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, ādhipateyyasaṃvattanikaṃ panāyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacita’nti.
dn16:4.42.13: cundassa ānanda kammāraputtassa evaṃ vippaṭisāro paṭivinetabbo”ti.
dn16:4.43.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
dn16:5.1.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi.
dn16:5.1.2: āyāmānanda, yena hiraññavatiyā nadiyā pārimaṃ tīraṃ, yena kusinārā, yena upavattanaṃ mallānaṃ sālavanaṃ, tenupasaṅkamissāmā’ti.
dn16:5.1.4: atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena hiraññavatiyā nadiyā pārimaṃ tīraṃ, yena kusinārā, yena upavattanaṃ mallānaṃ sālavanaṃ, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi.
dn16:5.1.5: “iṅgha me tvaṃ ānanda, antarena yamakasālānaṃ uttarasīsakaṃ mañcakaṃ paññāpehi. kilanto’smi ānanda, nipajjissāmī’ti.
dn16:5.1.6: ‘evambhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā antarena yamakasālānaṃ uttarasīsakaṃ mañcakaṃ paññāpesi.
dn16:5.1.7: atha kho bhagavā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno.
dn16:5.2.1: tena kho pana samayena yamakasālā sabbaphāliphullā honti akālapupphehi.
dn16:5.2.2: te tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.2.3: dibbāni pi mandāravapupphāni antaḷikkhā papatanti, tāni tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.2.4: dibbāni pi candanacuṇṇāni antaḷikkhā papatanti. tāni tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.2.5: dibbāni pi turiyāni antaḷikkhe vajjanti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.2.6: dibbāni pi saṅgītāni antaḷikkhe vattanti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.3.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:5.3.3: te tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.3.4: dibbāni pi mandāravapupphāni antaḷikkhā papatanti, tāni tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.3.5: dibbānipi candanacuṇṇāni antaḷikkhā papatanti, tāni tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.3.6: dibbāni pi turiyāni antaḷikkhe vajjanti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.3.7: dibbāni pi saṅgītāni antaḷikkhe vattanti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.3.8: na kho ānanda, ettāvatā tathāgato sakkato vā hoti garukato vā mānito vā pūjito vā apacito vā,
dn16:5.3.9: yo kho ānanda, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā upāsako vā upāsikā vā dhammānudhammapaṭipanno viharati sāmīcipaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so tathāgataṃ sakkaroti garukaroti māneti pūjeti apaciyati paramāya pūjāya.
dn16:5.3.10: tasmātihānanda, dhammānudhammapaṭipannā viharissāma sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino ti, evaṃ
dn16:5.3.11: hi vo ānanda sikkhitabbanti. upavāṇa thero
dn16:5.4.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upavāṇo bhagavato purato ṭhito hoti bhagavantaṃ vījamāno.
dn16:5.4.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ apasādesi:
dn16:5.4.5: ‘ayaṃ kho āyasmā upavāṇo dīgharattaṃ bhagavato upaṭṭhāko santikāvacaro samīpacārī.
dn16:5.4.6: atha ca pana bhagavā pacchime kāle āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ apasādesi:
dn16:5.4.7: apehi bhikkhu, mā me purato aṭṭhāsīti.
dn16:5.4.8: ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo yaṃ bhagavā āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ apasādesi.
dn16:5.4.9: apehi bhikkhu mā me purato aṭṭhāsīti.
dn16:5.5.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:5.5.2: ayaṃ bhante, āyasmā upavāṇo dīgharattaṃ bhagavato upaṭṭhāko santikāvacaro samīpacārī,
dn16:5.5.3: atha ca pana bhagavā pacchime kāle āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ apasādeti:
dn16:5.5.4: apehi bhikkhu, mā me purato aṭṭhāsīti.
dn16:5.5.5: ko nu kho bhante, hetu ko paccayo yaṃ bhagavā āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ apasādeti
dn16:5.5.6: apehi bhikkhu, mā me purato aṭṭhāsī’ti?
dn16:5.5.7: yebhuyyena ānanda, dasasu sahassisu lokadhātūsu devatā sannipatitā tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
dn16:5.5.8: yāvatā ānanda, kusinārā upavattanaṃ mallānaṃ sālavanaṃ samantato dvādasayojanāni, natthi so padeso vāḷaggakoṭinittudana mattopi mahesakkhāhi devatāhi apphuṭo.
dn16:5.5.10: dūrā ca vatamhā āgatā tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
dn16:5.5.11: kadāci karahaci tathāgatā loke uppajjanti arahanto sammāsambuddhā.
dn16:5.5.12: ajjeva rattiyā pacchime yāme tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:5.5.13: ayañca mahesakkho bhikkhu bhagavato purato ṭhito ovārento, na mayaṃ labhāma pacchime kāle tathāgataṃ dassanāyā’ti.
dn16:5.6.1: kathaṃ bhūtā pana bhante, bhagavā devatā manasi karotī’ti.
dn16:5.6.2: “santānanda, devatā ākāse pathavīsaññiniyo, kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti āvaṭṭanti, vivaṭṭantiatikhippaṃ
dn16:5.6.3: bhagavā parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ cakkhu loke antaradhāyissatī’ti.
dn16:5.6.4: santānanda, devatā paṭhaviyaṃ paṭhavīsaññiniyo kesepakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti:
dn16:5.6.5: atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ cakkhu loke antaradhāyissatīti!
dn16:5.6.6: yā pana tā devatā vītarāgā, tā satā sampajānadā adhivāsenti:
dn16:5.7.1: “pubbe bhante, disāsu vassaṃ vutthā bhikkhū āgacchanti tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
dn16:5.7.2: te mayaṃ labhāma manobhāvanīye bhikkhū dassanāya labhāma payirupāsanāya.
dn16:5.7.3: bhagavato pana mayaṃ bhante accayena na labhissāma manobhāvanīye bhikkhū dassanāya na labhissāma payirupāsanāyā”ti.
dn16:5.8.1: “cattārimāni ānanda, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyāni saṃvejanīyāni ṭhānāni.
dn16:5.8.3: ‘idha tathāgato jāto’ti ānanda, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
dn16:5.8.4: ‘idha tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho’ti ānanda, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
dn16:5.8.5: ‘idha tathāgatena anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitanti’ ānanda, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
dn16:5.8.6: ‘idha tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā’ parinibbutoti ānanda, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
dn16:5.8.7: imāni kho ānanda, cattāri saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyāni saṃvejanīyāni ṭhānāni.
dn16:5.8.8: āgamissanti kho ānanda, saddhā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo
dn16:5.8.9: idha tathāgato jāto ti pi, idha tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho ti pi, idha tathāgatena anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitantipi, idha tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbuto ti pi.
dn16:5.8.10: ye hi keci ānanda, cetiyacārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā pasannacittā kālaṃ karissanti, sabbe te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissantīti. ānanda pucchā kathā
dn16:5.10.3: iṅgha tumhe ānanda sadatthe, ghaṭatha sadatthamanuyujjatha, sadatthe appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharatha,
dn16:5.10.4: santānanda, khattiyapaṇḍitā pi brāhmaṇapaṇḍitā pi gahapatipaṇḍitā pi tathāgate abhippasannā te tathāgatassa sarīrapūjaṃ karissantī”ti.
dn16:5.11.2: “yathā kho ānanda, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti, evaṃ tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjitabbanti.”
dn16:5.11.3: “kathaṃ pana bhante, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjantī?”ti.
dn16:5.11.4: “rañño ānanda, cakkavattissa sarīraṃ ahatena vatthena veṭhentī. ahatena vatthena veṭhetvā vihatena kappāsena veṭhenti. vihatena kappāsena veṭhetvā ahatena vatthena veṭhenti.
dn16:5.11.5: etenupāyena pañcahi yugasatehi rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ veṭhetvā āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjitvā sabbagandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ jhāpenti.
dn16:5.11.7: evaṃ kho ānanda, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti.
dn16:5.11.8: yathā kho ānanda, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti. evaṃ tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjitabbaṃ
dn16:5.11.10: tattha ye mālaṃ vā gandhaṃ vā cuṇṇakaṃ vā āropessanti vā, abhivādessanti vā, cittaṃ vā pasādessanti, tesantaṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā”ti. thūpārahā puggalā
dn16:5.12.3: tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho thūpāraho, paccekasambuddho thūpāraho, tathāgatassa sāvako thūpāraho, rājā cakkavattī thūpāraho’ti.
dn16:5.12.4: kiñcānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho thūpāraho?
dn16:5.12.5: ayaṃ tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa thūpo’ti ānanda, bahū janā cittaṃ pasādenti.
dn16:5.12.6: te tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
dn16:5.12.7: idaṃ kho ānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho thūpāraho.
dn16:5.12.9: ayaṃ tassa bhagavato paccekasambuddhassa thūpo’ti ānanda, bahujanā cittaṃ pasādenti.
dn16:5.12.10: te tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
dn16:5.12.11: idaṃ kho ānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca paccekasambuddho thūpāraho.
dn16:5.12.12: kiñcānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca tathāgatassa sāvako thūpāraho?
dn16:5.12.13: ayaṃ tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sāvakassa thūpo’ti ānanda, bahū janā cittaṃ pasādenti.
dn16:5.12.14: te tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
dn16:5.12.15: idaṃ kho ānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca tathāgatassa sāvako thūpāraho.
dn16:5.12.16: kiñcānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca rājā cakkavattī thūpāraho?
dn16:5.12.17: ayaṃ dhammikassa dhammarañño thūpo’ti ānanda, bahū janā cittaṃ pasādenti.
dn16:5.12.18: te tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
dn16:5.12.19: idaṃ kho ānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca rājā cakkavattī thūpāraho.
dn16:5.12.20: ime kho ānanda cattāro thūpārahā”ti. ānandattherassa acchariyadhammā.
dn16:5.13.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando vihāraṃ pavisitvā kapisīsaṃ ālambitvā rodamāno aṭṭhāsi:
dn16:5.13.2: “ahañca vatamhi sekho sakaraṇīyo, satthu ca me parinibbānaṃ bhavissati yo mamaṃ anukampako”ti.
dn16:5.13.5: “eso bhante, āyasmā ānando vihāraṃ pavisitvā kapisīsaṃ ālambitvā rodamāno ṭhito:
dn16:5.13.6: ‘ahañca vatamhi sekho sakaraṇīyo satthu ca me parinibbānaṃ bhavissati yo mamaṃ ānukampako”ti.
dn16:5.13.7: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
dn16:5.13.8: “ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, mama vacanena ānandaṃ āmantehi:
dn16:5.13.10: “evambhante’ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:5.14.1: ‘evamāvuso’ti kho āyasmā ānando tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
dn16:5.14.2: “alaṃ ānanda mā soci, mā paridevi- nanu etaṃ ānanda, mayā paṭikacceva akkhātaṃ
dn16:5.14.3: sabbeheva piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo aññathābhāvo.
dn16:5.14.4: taṃ kutettha ānanda, labbhā ‘yantaṃ jātaṃ bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ palokadhammaṃ, taṃ vata tathāgatassāpi sarīraṃ mā palujjīti. netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
dn16:5.14.5: dīgharattaṃ kho te ānanda, tathāgato paccupaṭṭhito mettena kāyakammena hitena sukhena advayena appamāṇena, mettena vacīkammena …pe… mettena manokammena hitena sukhena advayena appamāṇena.
dn16:5.14.6: katapuñño’si tvaṃ ānanda padhānamanuyuñja, khippaṃ hehisi anāsavo”ti.
dn16:5.15.2: “ye pi te bhikkhave, ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, tesampi bhagavantānaṃ etaparamāyeva upaṭṭhākā ahesuṃ seyyathāpi mayhaṃ ānando.
dn16:5.15.3: ye pi te bhikkhave, bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, tesampi bhagavantānaṃ etaparamāyeva upaṭṭhākā bhavissanti seyyathāpi mayhaṃ ānando.
dn16:5.15.6: jānāti ‘ayaṃ kālo tathāgataṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ bhikkhūnaṃ, ayaṃ kālo bhikkhunīnaṃ, ayaṃ kālo upāsakānaṃ, ayaṃ kālo upāsikānaṃ, ayaṃ kālo rañño rājamahāmattānaṃ titthiyānaṃ titthiyasāvakānanti.’
dn16:5.16.1: cattāro’me bhikkhave, acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande.
dn16:5.16.3: sace bhikkhave, bhikkhuparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.
dn16:5.16.4: tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitena pi sā attamanā hoti.
dn16:5.16.5: atittā’va, bhikkhave, bhikkhuparisā hoti. atha kho ānando tuṇhī hoti.
dn16:5.16.12: upāsikāparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.
dn16:5.16.13: tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
dn16:5.16.14: atittā’va bhikkhave, upāsikāparisā hoti. atha kho ānando tuṇhī hoti.
dn16:5.16.15: ime kho bhikkhave, cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande.
dn16:5.16.16: cattāro’me bhikkhave, acchariyā abbhutā dhammā raññe cakkavattimhi.
dn16:5.16.18: sace bhikkhave, khattiyaparisā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.
dn16:5.16.19: tatra ce rājā cakkavattī bhāsati bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti,
dn16:5.16.20: atittā’va bhikkhave, khattiyaparisā hoti. atha kho rājā cakkavattī tuṇhī hoti.
dn16:5.16.23: samaṇaparisā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.
dn16:5.16.24: tatra ce rājā cakkavattī bhāsati bhāsitena pi sā attamanā hoti,
dn16:5.16.25: atittā’va bhikkhave, samaṇaparisā hoti. atha kho rājā cakkavattī tuṇhī hoti.
dn16:5.16.26: evameva kho bhikkhave, cattāro’me acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande.
dn16:5.16.27: sace bhikkhave, bhikkhuparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti,
dn16:5.16.28: tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitena pi sā attamanā hoti,
dn16:5.16.33: upāsikāparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti,
dn16:5.16.34: tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
dn16:5.16.37: ime kho bhikkhave, cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande’ti. [mahāsudassana sutta desanā.]
dn16:5.17.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:5.17.2: “mā bhante, bhagavā imasmiṃ kuḍḍanagarake ujjaṅgalanagarake sākhānagarake parinibbāyī.
dn16:5.17.4: campā rājagahaṃ sāvatthī sāketaṃ kosambī bārāṇasī.
dn16:5.17.6: ettha bahū khattiyamahāsālā brāhmaṇamahāsālā gahapatimahāsālā tathāgate abhippasannā.
dn16:5.18.1: ‘bhūtapubbaṃ ānanda, rājā mahāsudassano nāma ahosi cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
dn16:5.18.2: rañño ānanda, mahāsudassanassa ayaṃ kusinārā kusāvatī nāma rājadhānī ahosi.
dn16:5.18.3: puratthimena ca pacchimena ca dvādasayojanāni āyāmena, uttarena ca dakkhiṇena ca sattayojanāni vitthārena,
dn16:5.18.4: kusāvatī ānanda, rājadhānī iddhā ceva ahosi phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇamanussā ca subhikkhā ca.
dn16:5.18.5: seyyathāpi ānanda, devānaṃ āḷakamandā nāma rājadhānī iddhā ceva hoti phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇayakkhā ca subhikkhā ca,
dn16:5.18.6: evameva kho ānanda, kusāvatī rājadhānī iddhā ceva ahosi phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇamanussā ca subhikkhā ca.
dn16:5.18.7: kusāvatī ānanda, rājadhānī dasahi saddehi avivittā ahosi divā ceva rattiñca: seyyathidaṃ
dn16:5.18.8: hatthisaddena assasaddena rathasaddena bherisaddena mudiṅgasaddena vīṇāsaddena gītasaddena saṅkhasaddena sammasaddena tālasaddena asnātha pivatha khādathāti dasamena saddena.
dn16:5.19.1: gaccha tvaṃ ānanda, kusināraṃ pavisitvā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ ārocehi:
dn16:5.19.2: ajja kho vāseṭṭhā rattiyā pacchime yāme tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:5.19.5: amhākañca no gāmakkhette tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ ahosi, na mayaṃ labhimhā pacchime kāle tathāgataṃ dassanāyā”ti.
dn16:5.19.6: “evambhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya attadutiyo kusināraṃ pāvisi. mallānaṃ vandanā
dn16:5.20.1: tena kho pana samayena kosinārakā mallā santhāgāre sannipatitā honti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
dn16:5.20.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ santhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ ārocesi:
dn16:5.20.3: “ajja kho vāseṭṭhā rattiyā pacchime yāme tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:5.20.6: ‘amhākañca no gāmakkhette tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ ahosi, naṃ mayaṃ labhimhā pacchime kāle tathāgataṃ dassanāyā”ti.
dn16:5.21.1: idamāyasmato ānandassa vacanaṃ sutvā mallā ca mallaputtā ca mallasuṇisā ca mallapajāpatiyo ca aghāvino dummanā cetodukkhasamappitā appekacce kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ patanti, āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti
dn16:5.21.2: “atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ cakkhu loke antaradhāyissatī”ti.
dn16:5.21.3: atha kho mallā ca mallaputtā ca mallasuṇisā ca mallapajāpatiyo ca aghāvino dummanā cetodukkhasamappitā yena upavattanaṃ mallānaṃ sālavanaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
dn16:5.22.2: sace kho ahaṃ kosinārake malle ekamekaṃ bhagavantaṃ vandāpessamiṃ, avandito’va bhagavā kosinārakehi mallehi bhavissati. athāyaṃ ratti vibhāyissati.
dn16:5.22.3: yannūnāhaṃ kosinārake malle kulaparivattaso kulaparivattaso ṭhapetvā bhagavantaṃ vandāpeyyaṃ
dn16:5.22.4: ‘itthannāmo bhante mallo saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī’ti.
dn16:5.22.5: atha kho āyasmā ānando kosinārake malle kulaparivattaso kulaparivattaso ṭhapetvā bhagavantaṃ vandāpesi:
dn16:5.22.6: ‘itthannāmo bhante, mallo saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī’ti.
dn16:5.22.7: atha kho āyasmā ānando etena upāyena paṭhameneva yāmena kosinārake malle bhagavantaṃ vandāpesi. subhadda paribbājaka vatthu
dn16:5.23.1: tena kho pana samayena subhaddo nāma paribbājako kusinārāyaṃ paṭivasati.
dn16:5.23.3: ‘ajja kira rattiyā pacchime yāme samaṇassa gotamassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
dn16:5.23.5: “sutaṃ kho pana me’taṃ paribbājakānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
dn16:5.23.6: kadāci karahaci tathāgatā loke uppajjanti arahanto sammāsambuddhā’ti.
dn16:5.23.7: ajjeva rattiyā pacchime yāme samaṇassa gotamassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:5.23.8: atthi ca me ayaṃ kaṅkhādhammo uppanno.
dn16:5.23.9: evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ samaṇe gotame ‘pahoti me samaṇo gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ, yathāhaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyanti’.
dn16:5.24.1: atha kho subhaddo paribbājako yena upavattanaṃ mallānaṃ sālavanaṃ yena āyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:5.24.2: sutaṃ metaṃ bho ānanda paribbājakānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
dn16:5.24.3: “kadāci karahaci tathāgatā loke uppajjanti arahanto sammāsambuddhā”ti.
dn16:5.24.4: ajjeva rattiyā pacchime yāme samaṇassa gotamassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:5.24.5: atthi ca me ayaṃ kaṅkhādhammo uppanno,
dn16:5.24.6: “evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ samaṇe gotame, pahoti me samaṇo gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathāhaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyaṃ.
dn16:5.24.7: sādhāhaṃ bho ānanda, labheyyaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāyā”ti.
dn16:5.24.8: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando subhaddaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:5.24.9: ‘alaṃ āvuso subhadda, mā tathāgataṃ viheṭhesi, kilanto bhagavā”ti.
dn16:5.24.11: tatiyampi kho subhaddo paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:5.24.12: “sutaṃ metaṃ bho ānanda paribbājakānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
dn16:5.24.13: kadāci karahaci tathāgatā loke uppajjanti arahanto sammāsambuddhāti.
dn16:5.24.14: ajjeva rattiyā pacchime yāme samaṇassa gotamassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:5.24.15: atthi ca me ayaṃ kaṅkhā dhammo uppanno,
dn16:5.24.16: evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ samaṇe gotame, ‘pahoti me samaṇo gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathāhaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhā dhammaṃ pajaheyyaṃ’.
dn16:5.24.17: sādhāhaṃ bho ānanda, labheyyaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāyā”ti.
dn16:5.24.18: tatiyampi kho āyasmā ānando subhaddaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:5.24.19: “alaṃ āvuso subhadda, mā tathāgataṃ viheṭhesi, kilanto bhagavā”ti.
dn16:5.25.1: assosi kho bhagavā āyasmato ānandassa subhaddena paribbājakena saddhiṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
dn16:5.25.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:5.25.3: “alaṃ ānanda mā subhaddaṃ vāresi, labhataṃ ānanda subhaddo tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
dn16:5.25.4: yaṃ kiñci maṃ subhaddo pucchissati, sabbantaṃ aññāpekkho’va pucchissati no vihesāpekkho.
dn16:5.25.5: yañcassāhaṃ puṭṭho byākarissāmi, taṃ khippameva ājānissatī”ti.
dn16:5.25.6: atha kho āyasmā ānando subhaddaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:5.26.1: atha kho subhaddo paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho subhaddo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:5.26.2: ‘ye’me bho gotama, samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa,
dn16:5.26.3: seyyathidaṃ: pūraṇo kassapo, makkhali gosālo, ajito kesakambalo, pakudho kaccāyano, sañjayo belaṭṭhaputto, nigaṇṭho nātaputto,
dn16:5.26.4: sabbe te sakāya paṭiññāya abbhaññiṃsu, sabbeva na abbhaññiṃsu, udāhu ekacce abbhaññiṃsu, ekacce nābbhaññiṃsū?”ti.
dn16:5.26.6: sabbe te sakāya paṭiññāya abbhaññiṃsu, sabbeva na abbhaññiṃsu, udāhu ekacce abbhaññiṃsu, ekacce nābbhaññiṃsū”ti.
dn16:5.26.9: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho subhaddo paribbājako bhagavato paccassosi,
dn16:5.27.1: “yasmiṃ kho subhadda, dhammavinaye ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo na upalabbhati, samaṇo pi na upalabbhati, dutiyo pi tattha samaṇo na upalabbhati, tatiyo pi tattha samaṇo na upalabbhati, catuttho pi tattha samaṇo na upalabbhati.
dn16:5.27.2: yasmiñca kho subhadda, dhammavinaye ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo upalabbhati, samaṇopi tattha upalabbhati, dutiyo pi tattha samaṇo upalabbhati, tatiyo pi tattha samaṇo upalabbhati, catuttho pi tattha samaṇo upalabbhati.
dn16:5.27.3: imasmiṃ kho subhadda, dhammavinaye ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo upalabbhati, idhe va subhadda samaṇo, idha dutiyo samaṇo, idha tatiyo samaṇo, idha catuttho samaṇo. suññā parappavādā samaṇehi aññe.
dn16:5.27.4: ime ca subhadda, bhikkhū sammā vihareyyuṃ asuñño loko arahantehi assā”ti.
dn16:5.27.15: ime ca subhadda bhikkhū sammā vihareyyuṃ asuñño loko arahantehī”ti
dn16:5.28.1: evaṃ vutte subhaddo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:5.28.3: seyyathā pi bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintī’ti, evameva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn16:5.28.4: esāhaṃ bhante, bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
dn16:5.28.5: labheyyāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
dn16:5.29.1: “yo kho subhadda, aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati, pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ, so cattāro māse parivasati. catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya.
dn16:5.29.3: “sace bhante, aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye, ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ, cattāro māse parivasanti, catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya. ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi, catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājentu upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyā”ti.
dn16:5.29.4: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:5.30.1: atha kho subhaddo paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:5.30.2: “lābhā vo āvuso ānanda, suladdhaṃ vo āvuso ānanda,
dn16:5.30.3: ye ettha satthu sammukhā antevāsābhisekena abhisittā’ti.
dn16:5.30.4: alattha kho subhaddo paribbājako bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
dn16:5.30.5: acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā subhaddo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto, nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
dn16:5.30.6: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti abbhaññāsi.
dn16:5.30.7: aññataro kho panāyasmā subhaddo arahataṃ ahosi.
dn16:5.30.8: so ca, bhagavato pacchimo sakkhisāvako ahosī ti.
dn16:6.1.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmanteti.
dn16:6.1.4: na kho panetaṃ ānanda, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
dn16:6.1.5: yo kho ānanda, mayā dhammo ca vinayo ca desito paññatto so vo mamaccayena satthā ti.
dn16:6.2.1: yathā kho panānanda, etarahi bhikkhū aññamaññaṃ āvusovādena samudācaranti, na kho mamaccayena evaṃ samudācaritabbaṃ.
dn16:6.2.2: theratarena ānanda, bhikkhunā navakataro bhikkhu nāmena vā gottena vā āvusovādena vā samudācaritabbo.
dn16:6.2.3: navakatarena bhikkhunā therataro bhikkhu bhanteti vā āyasmāti vā samudācaritabbo.
dn16:6.3.1: ākaṅkhamāno ānanda, saṅgho mamaccayena khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhanatu.
dn16:6.4.1: channassa ānanda, bhikkhuno mamaccayena brahmadaṇḍo dātabbo”ti.
dn16:6.4.3: “channo ānanda, bhikkhu yaṃ iccheyya taṃ vadeyya,
dn16:6.4.4: so bhikkhūhi neva vattabbo na ovaditabbo na anusāsitabbo”ti.
dn16:6.5.2: siyā kho pana bhikkhave, ekabhikkhussāpi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā, pucchatha bhikkhave, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha:
dn16:6.5.3: sammukhībhūto no satthā ahosi, na mayaṃ sakkhimha bhagavantaṃ sammukhā paṭipucchitunti.
dn16:6.5.4: evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
dn16:6.6.3: siyā kho pana bhikkhave, ekabhikkhussāpi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā pucchatha bhikkhave, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha,
dn16:6.6.4: sammukhībhūto no satthā ahosi, na mayaṃ sakkhimha bhagavantaṃ sammukhā paṭipucchitunti.
dn16:6.6.5: tatiyampi kho te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
dn16:6.6.7: “siyā kho pana bhikkhave, satthugāravenāpi na puccheyyātha. sahāyako pi bhikkhave, sahāyakassa ārocetū’ti.
dn16:6.6.8: evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
dn16:6.6.9: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:6.6.10: “acchariyaṃ bhante, abbhutaṃ bhante, evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ bhante, imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe ‘natthi ekabhikkhussāpi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā’ti.
dn16:6.6.11: “pasādā kho tvaṃ ānanda vadesi. ñāṇameva hettha ānanda tathāgatassa. natthi imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe ekabhikkhussāpi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā.
dn16:6.6.12: imesaṃ hi ānanda, pañcannaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ yo pacchimako bhikkhu so sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’ti.
dn16:6.7.4: ayaṃ tathāgatassa pacchimā vācā. bhagavato parinibbānaṃ
dn16:6.8.1: atha kho bhagavā paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji. paṭhamajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji. dutiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji. tatiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji. catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samāpajji. ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpajji. viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajji. ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajji. nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajji.
dn16:6.8.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca,
dn16:6.8.4: “na āvuso ānanda, bhagavā parinibbuto saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno”ti.
dn16:6.9.1: atha kho bhagavā saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajji. nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajji. ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpajji. viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samāpajji. ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji. catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji. tatiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji. dutiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji. paṭhamajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji. dutiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji. tatiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji. catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā samanantarā bhagavā parinibbāyi.
dn16:6.10.1: parinibbute bhagavati saha parinibbānā mahābhūmicālo ahosi, bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso. devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
dn16:6.10.2: parinibbute bhagavati saha parinibbānā brahmā sahampati imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi:
dn16:6.10.9: parinibbute bhagavati saha parinibbānā sakko devānamindo imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi:
dn16:6.10.14: parinibbute bhagavati saha parinibbānā āyasmā anuruddho imā gāthāyo abhāsi:
dn16:6.10.23: parinibbute bhagavati saha parinibbānā āyasmā ānando imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi:
dn16:6.10.28: “parinibbute bhagavati ye te tattha bhikkhū avītarāgā appekacce bāhā paggayha kandanti chinnapātaṃ patanti āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti:” atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbuto atikhippaṃ cakkhu loke antarahitanti.
dn16:6.10.29: ye pana te bhikkhū vītarāgā te satā sampajānā ‘adhivāsenti
dn16:6.11.1: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho bhikkhū āmantesi:
dn16:6.11.2: alaṃ āvuso, mā socittha mā paridevittha.
dn16:6.11.3: nanu etaṃ āvuso, bhagavatā paṭigacceva akkhātaṃ,
dn16:6.11.4: sabbeheva piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo aññathābhāvo,
dn16:6.11.5: taṃ kutettha āvuso, labbhā yantaṃ jātaṃ bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ palokadhammaṃ taṃ vata mā palujjīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
dn16:6.11.7: “kathambhūtā pana bhante, anuruddha devatā manasi karoti?
dn16:6.11.8: santāvuso ānanda, devatā ākāse paṭhavisaññiniyo kese pakiriya kandanti bāhā paggayha kandanti chinnapātaṃ patanti, āvaṭṭanti, vivaṭṭanti
dn16:6.11.9: atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ cakkhu loke antarahitanti.
dn16:6.11.10: santāvuso ānanda, devatā paṭhaviyā paṭhavisaññiniyo kese pakiriya
dn16:6.11.12: yā pana tā devatā vītarāgā tā satā sampajānā adhivāsenti
dn16:6.11.14: atha kho āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca ānando taṃ rattāvasesaṃ dhammiyā kathāya vītināmesuṃ.
dn16:6.12.1: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:6.12.2: gacchāvuso ānanda, kusināraṃ. kusināraṃ pavisitvā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ ārocehi:
dn16:6.12.5: evambhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando āyasmato anuruddhassa paṭissutvā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya attadutiyo kusināraṃ pāvisi.
dn16:6.12.6: tena kho pana samayena kosinārakā mallā santhāgāre sannipatitā honti teneva karaṇīyena.
dn16:6.12.7: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ santhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ ārocesi:
dn16:6.12.10: idamāyasmato ānandassa vacanaṃ sutvā mallā ca mallaputtā ca mallasuṇisā ca mallapajāpatiyo ca aghāvino dummanā ceto dukkhasamappitā appekacce kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ patanti āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti
dn16:6.12.11: atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ cakkhu loke antarahinti.”
dn16:6.13.1: atha kho kosinārakā mallā purise āṇāpesuṃ
dn16:6.13.2: “tena hi bhaṇe kusinārāyaṃ gandhamālañca sabbañca tāḷāvacaraṃ sannipātethā”ti.
dn16:6.13.3: atha kho kosinārakā mallā gandhamālañca sabbañca tāḷāvacaraṃ pañca ca dussayugasatāni ādāya yena upavattanaṃ mallānaṃ sālavanaṃ yena bhagavato sarīraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garukarontā mānentā pūjentā celavitānāni karontā maṇḍalamāḷe paṭiyādentā ‘ekadivasaṃ vītināmesuṃ.
dn16:6.13.5: ‘ativikālo kho ajja bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpetuṃ, svedāni mayaṃ bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpessāmā”ti.
dn16:6.13.6: atha kho kosinārakā mallā bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garukarontā mānentā pūjentā celavitānāni karontā maṇḍalamāḷe paṭiyādentā dutiyampi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ, tatiyampi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ, catutthampi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ, pañcamampi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ, chaṭṭhampi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ.
dn16:6.14.1: atha kho sattamaṃ divasaṃ kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ etadahosi:
dn16:6.14.2: mayaṃ bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garukarontā mānentā pūjentā, dakkhiṇena dakkhiṇaṃ nagarassa haritvā bāhirena bāhiraṃ dakkhiṇato nagarassa bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpessāmā’ti.
dn16:6.14.3: tena kho pana samayena aṭṭha mallapāmokkhā sīsaṃ nahātā ahatāni vatthāni nivatthā
dn16:6.14.5: atha kho kosinārakā mallā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn16:6.14.6: ko nu kho bhante anuruddha, hetu ko paccayo yenime aṭṭha mallapāmokkhā sīsaṃ nahātā ahatāni vatthāni nivatthā
dn16:6.14.7: ‘mayaṃ bhagavato sarīraṃ uccāressāmā’ti na sakkonti uccāretunti?”
dn16:6.14.8: “aññathā kho vāsiṭṭhā, tumhākaṃ adhippāyo, aññathā devatānaṃ adhippāyo”ti.
dn16:6.15.3: “mayaṃ bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garukarontā mānentā pūjentā dakkhiṇena dakkhiṇaṃ nagarassa haritvā, bāhirena bāhiraṃ dakkhiṇato nagarassa bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpessāmā”ti.
dn16:6.15.5: “mayaṃ bhagavato sarīraṃ dibbehi naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garukarontā mānentā pūjentā, uttarena uttaraṃ nagarassa haritvā, uttarena dvārena nagaraṃ pavesetvā, majjhena majjhaṃ nagarassa haritvā, puratthimena dvārena nikkhāmetvā, puratthimato nagarassa makuṭabandhanaṃ nāma mallānaṃ cetiyaṃ, ettha bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpessāmā”ti.
dn16:6.16.1: tena kho pana samayena kusinārā yāva sandhisamalasaṃkaṭīrā jaṇṇumattena odhinā mandāravapupphehi santhatā hoti.
dn16:6.16.2: atha kho devatā ca kosinārakā ca mallā bhagavato sarīraṃ dibbehi ca mānusakehi ca naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garukarontā mānentā pūjentā, uttarena uttaraṃ nagarassa haritvā, uttarena dvārena nagaraṃ pavesetvā, majjhena majjhaṃ nagarassa haritvā, puratthimena dvārena nikkhamitvā, puratthimato nagarassa makuṭabandhanaṃ nāma mallānaṃ cetiyaṃ, tattha bhagavato sarīraṃ nikkhipiṃsu.
dn16:6.17.1: atha kho kosinārakā mallā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn16:6.17.2: “kathaṃ mayaṃ bhante ānanda, tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjāmā?”ti.
dn16:6.17.3: “yathā kho vāsiṭṭhā, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti, evaṃ tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjitabbanti.”
dn16:6.17.4: “kathaṃ pana bhante ānanda, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjantī”ti.
dn16:6.17.5: “rañño vāsiṭṭhā, cakkavattissa sarīraṃ ahatena vatthena veṭhenti, ahatena vatthena veṭhetvā vihatena kappāsena veṭhenti. vihatena kappāsena veṭhetvā ahatena vatthena veṭhenti.
dn16:6.17.6: etena upāyena pañcahi yugasatehi rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ veṭhetvā āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjetvā, sabbagandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ jhāpenti.
dn16:6.17.8: evaṃ kho vāsiṭṭhā, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti.
dn16:6.17.9: yathā kho vāsiṭṭhā, rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti, evaṃ tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
dn16:6.17.11: tattha ye mālaṃ vā gandhaṃ vā cuṇṇakaṃ vā āropessanti vā abhivādessanti vā cittaṃ vā pasādessanti, tesantaṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā”ti.
dn16:6.18.1: atha kho kosinārakā mallā purise āṇāpesuṃ
dn16:6.18.2: “tena hi bhaṇe, mallānaṃ vihataṃ kappāsaṃ sannipātethā”ti.
dn16:6.18.3: atha kho kosinārakā mallā bhagavato sarīraṃ ahatena vatthena veṭhesuṃ. ahatena vatthena veṭhetvā vihatena kappāsena veṭhesuṃ. vihatena kappāsena veṭhetvā ahatena vatthena veṭhesuṃ.
dn16:6.18.4: etena upāyena pañcahi yugasatehi bhagavato sarīraṃ veṭhetvā āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjetvā sabbagandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā bhagavato sarīraṃ citakaṃ āropesuṃ. mahākassapāgamanaṃ.
dn16:6.19.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākassapo pāvāya kusināraṃ addhānamaggappaṭipanno hoti mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi.
dn16:6.19.2: atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
dn16:6.19.3: tena kho pana samayena aññataro ājīvako kusinārāya mandāravapupphaṃ gahetvā pāvaṃ addhānamaggappaṭipanno hoti.
dn16:6.19.4: addasā kho āyasmā mahākassapo taṃ ājīvakaṃ dūrato’va āgacchantaṃ. disvā taṃ ājīvakaṃ etadavoca:
dn16:6.19.6: āma āvuso jānāmi. ajja sattāhaparinibbuto samaṇo gotamo.
dn16:6.19.8: tattha ye te bhikkhū avītarāgā appekacce bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ patanti, āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti:
dn16:6.19.9: atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ cakkhu loke antarahitanti,
dn16:6.19.10: ye pana te bhikkhū vītarāgā, te satā sampajānā adhivāsenti:
dn16:6.20.1: tena kho pana samayena subhaddo nāma buḍḍhapabbajito tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
dn16:6.20.2: atha kho subhaddo buḍḍhapabbajito te bhikkhū etadavoca:
dn16:6.20.3: “alaṃ āvuso, mā socittha, mā paridevittha. sumuttā mayaṃ tena mahāsamaṇena. upaddutā ca homa
dn16:6.20.4: idaṃ vo kappati, idaṃ vo na kappatī’ti.
dn16:6.20.5: idāni pana mayaṃ yaṃ icchissāma taṃ karissāma, yaṃ na icchissāma na taṃ karissāmā”ti.
dn16:6.20.6: atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo bhikkhū āmantesi:
dn16:6.20.8: nanu etaṃ āvuso bhagavatā paṭigacce va akkhātaṃ:
dn16:6.20.9: sabbeheva piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo aññathābhāvo.
dn16:6.20.10: taṃ kutettha āvuso, labbhā yantaṃ jātaṃ bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ palokadhammaṃ, taṃ tathāgatassāpi sarīraṃ mā palujjīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatī”ti.
dn16:6.21.1: tena kho pana samayena cattāro mallapāmokkhā sīsaṃ nhātā ahatāni vatthāni nivatthā
dn16:6.21.2: mayaṃ bhagavato citakaṃ ālimpessāmāti na sakkonti ālimpetuṃ.
dn16:6.21.3: atha kho kosinārakā mallā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn16:6.21.4: ko nu kho bhante anuruddha hetu, ko paccayo, yenime cattāro mallapāmokkhā sīsaṃ nhātā ahatāni vatthāni nivatthā
dn16:6.21.5: mayaṃ bhagavato citakaṃ ālimpessāmāti na sakkonti ālimpetunti”?
dn16:6.21.9: ayaṃ āyasmā mahākassapo pāvāya kusināraṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi.
dn16:6.21.10: na tāva bhagavato citako pajjalissati yāvāyasmā mahākassapo bhagavato pāde sirasā na vandissatī”ti.
dn16:6.22.1: atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo yena kusinārā makuṭabandhanaṃ nāma mallānaṃ cetiyaṃ yena bhagavato citako tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ citakaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā, pādato vivaritvā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandi.
dn16:6.22.2: tāni pi kho pañca bhikkhusatāni ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā añjalimpaṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ citakaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandiṃsu.
dn16:6.22.3: vanditesu ca panāyasmatā mahākassapena tehi pi pañcahi bhikkhusatehi, sayameva bhagavato citako pajjali.
dn16:6.23.1: jhāyamānassa kho pana bhagavato sarīrassa, yaṃ ahosi chavīti vā cammanti vā maṃsanti vā nahāru ti vā lasikā ti vā tassa neva chārikā paññāyittha, na masi.
dn16:6.23.3: seyyathāpi nāma sappissa vā telassa vā jhāyamānassa neva chārikā paññāyati na masi,
dn16:6.23.4: evameva bhagavato sarīrassa jhāyamānassa yaṃ ahosi chavīti vā cammanti vā maṃsanti vā nahārūti vā lasikāti vā tassa neva chārikā paññāyittha’na masi,
dn16:6.23.6: tesañca pañcannaṃ dussayugasatānaṃ dveva dussāni na ḍayhiṃsu yañca sabbabbhantarimaṃ yañca bāhiraṃ.
dn16:6.23.7: daḍḍhe ca kho pana bhagavato sarīre antaḷikkhā udakadhārā pātubhavitvā bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesi.
dn16:6.23.8: udakaṃ sālato pi abbhunnamitvā bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesi.
dn16:6.23.9: kosinārakā pi mallā sabbagandhodakena bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesuṃ.
dn16:6.23.10: atha kho kosinārakā mallā bhagavato sarīrāni sattāhaṃ santhāgāre sattipañjaraṃ karitvā dhanupākāraṃ parikkhipāpetvā naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkariṃsu garukariṃsu mānesuṃ pūjesuṃ. sārīrikadhātuvibhajanā
dn16:6.24.1: assosi kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto:
dn16:6.24.3: atha kho rājā māgadho: ajātasattu vedehiputto kosināratānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesi
dn16:6.24.4: “bhagavā pi khattiyo ahampi khattiyo. ahampi arahāmi bhagavato sārīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, ahampi bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmī”ti.
dn16:6.24.7: atha kho vesālikā licchavī kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ:
dn16:6.24.8: “bhagavā pi khattiyo mayampi khattiyā. mayampi arahāma bhagavato sārīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ. mayampi bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmā”ti.
dn16:6.24.11: atha kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ:
dn16:6.24.12: “bhagavā amhākaṃ ñātiseṭṭho. mayampi arahāma bhagavato sārīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ. mayampi bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca kārissāmā”ti.
dn16:6.24.15: atha kho allakappakā bulayo kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ:
dn16:6.24.16: “bhagavā pi khattiyo mayampi khattiyā, mayampi arahāma bhagavato sārīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ. mayampi bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmā”ti.
dn16:6.24.19: atha kho rāmagāmakā koliyā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ:
dn16:6.24.20: “bhagavā pi khattiyo, mayampi khattiyā, mayampi arahāma bhagavato sārīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ. mayampi bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmā”ti.
dn16:6.24.23: atha kho veṭhadīpako brāhmaṇo kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesi:
dn16:6.24.24: “bhagavā tu khattiyo. ahamasmi brāhmaṇo, ahampi arahāmi bhagavato sārīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ. ahampi bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmī”ti.
dn16:6.24.27: atha kho pāveyyakā mallā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ.
dn16:6.24.28: bhagavā pi khattiyo mayampi khattiyā. mayampi arahāma bhagavato sārīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayampi bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmā”ti.
dn16:6.25.1: evaṃ vutte kosinārakā mallā te saṅghe gaṇe etadavocuṃ,
dn16:6.25.2: bhagavā amhākaṃ gāmakkhette parinibbuto, na mayaṃ dassāma bhagavato sārīrānaṃ bhāganti.
dn16:6.25.3: evaṃ vutte doṇo brāhmaṇo te saṅghe gaṇe etadavoca:
dn16:6.25.12: “tena hi brāhmaṇa, tvaññeva bhagavato sārīrāni aṭṭhadhā samaṃ suvibhattaṃ vibhajāhī”ti.
dn16:6.25.13: ‘evaṃ bho’ti kho doṇo brāhmaṇo tesaṃ saṅghānaṃ gaṇānaṃ paṭissutvā bhagavato sārīrāni aṭṭhadhā samaṃ suvibhattaṃ vibhajitvā te saṅghe gaṇe etadavoca:
dn16:6.25.14: “imaṃ me bhonto tumbaṃ dadantu, ahampi tumbassa thūpañca mahañca karissāmī”ti.
dn16:6.25.15: adaṃsu kho te doṇassa brāhmaṇassa tumbaṃ.
dn16:6.26.3: atha kho pippalivaniyā moriyā kosinārakānaṃ mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ:
dn16:6.26.4: bhagavā pi khattiyo mayampi khattiyā. mayampi arahāma bhagavato sārīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayampi bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca karissāmā’ti.
dn16:6.26.5: “natthi bhagavato sārīrānaṃ bhāgo, vibhattāni bhagavato sārīrāni,
dn16:6.27.1: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto rājagahe bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akāsi.
dn16:6.27.2: vesālikā pi licchavī vesāliyaṃ bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.3: kāpilavatthavā pi sakyā kapilavatthusmiṃ bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.4: allakappakā pi bulayo allakappe bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.5: rāmagāmakā pi koliyā rāmagāme bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.6: veṭhadīpako pi brāhmaṇo veṭhadīpe bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akāsi.
dn16:6.27.7: pāveyyakāpi mallā pāvāyaṃ bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.8: kosinārakā pi mallā kusinārāyaṃ bhagavato sārīrānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.9: doṇo pi brāhmaṇo tumbassa thūpañca mahañca akāsi.
dn16:6.27.10: pippalivaniyā pi moriyā pippalivane aṅgārānaṃ thūpañca mahañca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.11: iti aṭṭha sarīrathūpā navamo tumbathūpo dasamo aṅgārathūpo.
